title: AI Engineer – Generative Agentic Platforms (Python)
description:

* Design, build and deploy autonomous or semi-autonomous agents using platforms like Agno, CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen or similar

* Build scalable backend systems and services, integrating AI components into enterprise-grade systems
* Work closely with product and data teams to define requirements and validate AI-driven functionality
* Optimize the performance, reliability and cost of GenAI workloads and APIs
* Keep up with the latest developments in GenAI and agentic AI

**What You’ll Need**

* 3+ years of Experience
* Hands-on experience with agentic AI platforms such as Agno, CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen or similar
* Strong Python skills, particularly in AI/ML, automation and integration
* Proficiency in at least one of Java, C++ or C# for enterprise software and backend APIs
* Understanding of LLM ecosystems (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.), prompt engineering and tool augmentation

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with API integration, vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone) and knowledge graphs

Apply directly through Indeed with your resume. Links to GitHub projects or deployed agent demos are a plus.

title: AI Intern
description:
**About ARCHLE Labs**

ARCHLE Labs – Advanced Research Centre for Health And Life Science Engineering is a health-tech R&D startup based in Bangalore. Our team comprises experienced healthcare professionals and entrepreneurs passionate about making a difference in the world.

**“Our mission is to drive innovations to solve complex medical challenges and enhance human well-being.”**

Our commitment lies in harnessing the power of science and engineering to create tangible solutions that empower the health of individuals and communities worldwide.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to join our Research & Development team. In this role, you will work on cutting-edge Generative AI, NLP, and machine learning applications focused on solving real-world healthcare and life science challenges.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying intelligent AI systems using modern LLM frameworks, RAG pipelines, and deep learning technologies. This is a high-impact opportunity to work closely with the CEO and leadership team in a fast-paced startup environment where innovation and ownership are highly valued.

If you are passionate about artificial intelligence, large language models, and building meaningful AI-driven healthcare solutions, we’d love to meet you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and deploy AI/ML applications using Python
* Build and optimize NLP and Generative AI workflows
* Design and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines
* Work with vector databases and embedding models
* Develop AI agents and workflows using LangChain and LangGraph
* Build scalable APIs and backend services using FastAPI
* Perform prompt engineering and optimize LLM performance
* Work with Hugging Face models, transformers, and open-source AI frameworks
* Research, test, and evaluate new AI/ML technologies and advancements
* Assist in fine-tuning and optimizing deep learning/LLM models
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into products
* Participate in end-to-end model deployment and monitoring
* Maintain technical documentation and development workflows
* Work closely with leadership on AI product strategy and innovation

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field
* 0-1 years of experience
* Strong proficiency in Python and AI/ML application development
* Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM workflows
* Practical experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and FastAPI
* Good understanding of RAG pipelines and vector embeddings
* Knowledge of prompt engineering techniques
* Familiarity with Hugging Face ecosystem and transformer architectures
* Understanding of machine learning algorithms and deep learning fundamentals
* Basic experience with fine-tuning deep learning or LLM models
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced startup environment
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Passion for learning, research, and staying updated with advancements in AI and machine learning

**Nice to Have (Optional)**

* Experience with AWS EC2 and SageMaker
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure
* Knowledge of GraphRAG architectures
* Experience working with PostgreSQL
* End-to-end AI model deployment experience
* Experience building scalable production AI systems
* Exposure to healthcare AI applications or health-tech products
* Experience working in startup or R&D environments

**What We Offer Here**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Potential ESOP grants based on performance and tenure
* Opportunity to work closely with founders, CEO, and leadership team
* High ownership role with significant growth potential
* Collaborative and innovative work environment
* Professional development and research opportunities
* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and healthcare technologies
* The chance to make a significant impact on healthcare innovation

* Quality

title: Senior Engineer, AI Security
description:
The **AI Security Engineer** is responsible for building and running the security controls that find and govern the use of artificial intelligence across Danaher, including chat tools, AI platforms, and autonomous agents. The engineer configures and tunes policies and detections in CrowdStrike Falcon and AI gateways, and builds the automation that lets Danaher adopt AI safely.

This position reports to the **Senior Manager, AI Security & Governance** and is part of the **DIS Corporate Cybersecurity - AI Security** team located in **Bangalore or Pune India** and will be an on-site role.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Configure, tune, and maintain security policies for the AI control plane in CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) and Falcon Shield, including access rules, prompt rules, and report, transform, or block actions.
* Manage policy and configuration for AI gateways that cover gaps the CrowdStrike tools cannot reach.
* Build alerts and detections for unapproved AI use, risky agent behavior, and policy violations, aligned to the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications.
* Build the automation yourself: prove a task by hand in the platform, then automate it with Python, PowerShell, and platform APIs.
* Contribute to AI security design with the AI Security Architect, and coordinate with the Security Operations Center and the CrowdStrike engineering team.

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 9+ years of security engineering experience, including hands-on work on endpoint, software-as-a-service, or cloud security platforms.
* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, or customizing CrowdStrike Falcon, such as policy authoring, integrations, detection logic, or console administration.
* Experience writing and tuning detection logic and security policy, and building automation for it with Python, PowerShell, or platform APIs.
* Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications, including how prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agency map to policy or detection logic.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (now Falcon Guardian) or Falcon Shield.
* AI gateways or AI security platforms (such as JetStream, LiteLLM, or Prisma AIRS), or security for Copilot Studio and Power Platform.

As a Technical Systems Engineer in the Group Real Estate, you will be at the heart of a foundational transformation in IWMS.
  
  
This means that you will:
  

* Cloud architecture: implement and maintain secure, scalable cloud architectures for real estate and smart building solutions on GCP, Azure or AWS.

* IoT & smart buildings: integrate IoT device connectivity and smart building systems (BMS, energy meters, occupancy and environmental sensors) using protocols such as MQTT, BACnet and OPC UA.
* Back-end & full-stack development: Build APIs, microservices and, where needed, web front-ends that expose building data and insights to users and other systems (including the IWMS / Planon).
* Large projects: Lead the technical workstream on large, multi-site projects – from solution design and estimation through build, rollout and handover to operations.

* Data platform - Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, data lake / lakehouse architecture

* Data engineering - Advanced: Batch & streaming pipelines, Kafka / Pub/Sub, time-series data, data modelling, data quality

* Security & governance - IAM, network security, secrets management, data governance, GDPR

This is our wish list!
  
  
The must-haves we see for this role are:
  

* Hands-on experience in software and data engineering, with a track record of delivering large, complex projects.
* Cloud architecture: background in cloud architecture on GCP and/or Azure / AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, managed data services).
* Software engineering: Full-stack experience with back-end focus – designing and building APIs, services and integrations.
* Python: Intermediate Python skills for data engineering and back-end development.
* Databricks: Hands-on experience with Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, workflows, Unity Catalog).

Nice to have:

* Digital twin or BIM-based platforms.
* Machine learning / MLOps (MLflow) for energy optimisation and predictive maintenance.
* Energy management, ESG and sustainability reporting.
* BI tools such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau.

  
Personal Competencies:
  

* Passion to write code and build solutions.
* Balancing long-term design with pragmatic delivery.
* Clear communicator who can explain complex technology to business stakeholders.
* Curious and forward-looking mindset, with a willingness to explore and learn new technologies, identify their potential, and uncover business value through AI including opportunities to develop and work with agentic AI solutions

Education and certifications:
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or equivalent experience.
* Cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solutions Architect – Professional are a plus.

The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is leading the foundational transformation in HR Tech — with a clear vision: to bring trustworthy data to business leaders so they can make informed decisions. We sit at the intersection of HR, data, and technology, and we believe that getting the foundation right is what makes everything else possible.
  
  
We are a team that believes in:

title: Support Engineer
description:
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Full-time

**About the job**
-----------------

**About Signeasy**

**Contracts run businesses. We're unlocking the intelligence inside them.**

Signeasy began 16 years ago with a simple idea: signing should be easy. That idea helped the world go paperless. But signatures were only the beginning.

Today, the real problem isn't signing contracts. It's what happens after. In most companies, contracts sit scattered across inboxes, shared drives, CLMs, ERPs, and filing systems. They're static, forgotten, and underused, yet they quietly define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. We believe contracts are one of the most powerful and most overlooked sources of truth in a business.

2025 changed everything. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we began turning them into living, searchable, and intelligent systems of record. We shipped more than 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and were featured at Apple's WWDC, all while building the foundation for what comes next.

2026 is our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we're going to market with an AI-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software.

This is the moment, and this is the team building it. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, read on.

  

**Your role**

As our Support Engineer, you'll be part of the Customer Support team and the technical voice of Signeasy for our customers. You'll resolve the issues that need more than a help article: API errors, integration failures, SSO setups, mobile app, and tricky account problems. You'll handle tickets end to end and get on calls with our enterprise and API customers when a conversation works better than an email thread.

You'll be the bridge between customers and our engineering team. When something is broken, you'll reproduce it, find the root cause where you can, and hand engineering a clean, well-documented ticket. When something is confusing, you'll fix it at the source with better docs, macros, and product feedback.

If you enjoy digging into logs, love the moment a stubborn issue finally clicks, and care about leaving every customer better off than you found them, you'll find a lot to love here.

  

**What you'll do**

**Ticket resolution**

* Own tickets across email, chat, and phone, from first response to resolution, within our support SLAs
* Take escalations from the frontline team and resolve complex issues across our web app, iOS and Android apps, eSign API, and Intelligent Contract Management
* Troubleshoot integrations with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, Salesforce, and other tools our customers rely on
* Keep customers informed with clear, honest updates, and manage expectations on timelines and workarounds

**Enterprise and API customers**

* Join calls with enterprise and API customers to debug live issues, walk through setups, and answer technical questions
* Help developers integrate our eSign API: review their requests, read error responses, and point them to best practices
* Support admins with account configuration, SSO/SAML, user management, and compliance-related questions

**Debugging and escalation to engineering**

* Reproduce issues across platforms, and investigate using logs, HAR files, browser dev tools, API tools such as Postman, and SQL queries
* Separate configuration issues from real bugs, and file well-documented Jira tickets with steps to reproduce, impact, and customer context
* Follow escalations through to closure and close the loop with the customer

**Knowledge and product feedback**

* Write and update help center articles, internal runbooks, and Zendesk macros so the next customer or teammate solves it faster
* Spot recurring issues and trends, and share them with Product and Engineering to improve the product
* Respond to app store reviews that need a technical answer

**AI and automation**

* Use AI tools to investigate issues, draft responses, and summarize ticket trends
* Build simple scripts, automations, and templates that cut repetitive work for the support team
  

**Who you are**

We're looking for someone technical, curious, and customer-first: a problem solver who takes ownership and doesn't let an issue go cold.

* 3 to 4 years of experience in technical or product support for a B2B SaaS product
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, and JSON, with hands-on experience using Postman or similar tools
* Comfort reading logs, analyzing HAR files, and using browser developer tools
* Experience troubleshooting web and mobile apps
* Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar helpdesk) and Jira
* Confidence leading customer calls, including with technical and enterprise stakeholders
* Strong written and spoken English, with a clear, empathetic, and crisp communication style
* Self-driven, organized, and calm under pressure, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities
  

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with SSO/SAML, OAuth, and webhooks
* Exposure to integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365
* Basic scripting in Python or JavaScript
* Experience with iOS or Android debugging tools
  

**Why you'll love this role**

This role sits at the center of everything we ship. You'll work with customers of every size, from individual professionals to enterprise and API teams, and partner closely with Product and Engineering to make Signeasy better every week.

Your work will directly shape how customers experience Signeasy: how quickly their problems are solved, how much they trust us, and how the product improves based on what they tell us.

It's a high-ownership role with clear room to grow, into senior support, support operations, solutions engineering, or product, depending on where your interests take you.

  

**Why work with Signeasy**

Our values make us a TIGER: Trust, Integrity, Growth mindset, Empathy, and Responsibility.

We're a lean, close-knit, and nimble team. We're opinionated but collaborative: we disagree, then commit to a shared decision. We're modern, but we don't follow trends blindly. We're easy to work with, and we believe in having difficult conversations. We ask lots of questions, experiment, and learn fast. And we're deeply empathetic toward our customers, our colleagues, and ourselves.

Our people are our greatest asset. You'll work alongside some of the smartest, most humble people around the world, who come from diverse backgrounds and bring a wide range of experiences. We're a hybrid-friendly organization that values flexibility, with a mix of in-person collaboration at the office and focused work from home.

We are the #SigneasyTribe. Ask us plenty of questions about our culture, so we can both see whether there's a real connection that makes this a great experience for both of us.

  

**We'd love to hear from you**

Great talent comes from all kinds of paths. If this role speaks to you, please apply, even if you don't match every line on paper. We review every application and will get back to you within a week.

* Hear what it's like to work at Signeasy
* Meet Signeasy's leadership team
* Read our origin story
* Take a peek at Signeasy's culture
* Learn more about growth at Signeasy

Signeasy is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* Expert-level proficiency with **VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), vCenter, ESXi**, and enterprise‑scale virtualization management
* Extensive hands-on experience with **VMware Aria Automation (vRA/vRealize), Aria Operations, and orchestration tooling**, including lifecycle management, blueprints, policies, and extensibility

Our purpose is to foster human progress through knowledge. We strongly believe that this requires us to encourage and examine different ideas and voices, so that any work that meets our exacting levels of quality deserves to be included in our publications. This requires open minds, the opportunity for robust debate, and the courage to defend perspectives that stand up to scrutiny, even if they conflict with our personal beliefs or values. Because that’s the only way to find the best obtainable version of the truth and, ultimately, foster human progress. If you agree, then we’d love to hear from you.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Quality Engineer with strong expertise in automation and modern Quality Engineering practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience on creating automated data validation scripts to test ETL data pipelines and report bugs or glitches. This position requires hands-on experience in ETL Testing and Automated Test Development. You will also be responsible for UI, API, backend, and performance testing, with a passion for engineering scalable automation solutions, driving quality throughout the SDLC, and leveraging AI-powered tools to improve software quality and delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and manage the data quality framework across production data pipelines.
* Build reusable data quality checks using tools such as Great Expectations or equivalent frameworks.
* Working with large and complex data sets (SQL and No-SQL), data lakes (S3) and data warehouses (Redshift).
* Test Automation - Build automated data validation scripts to test the quality of data in data lake (S3) and data warehouses (Redshift).
* Define checks for schema, null values, uniqueness, referential integrity, data volume, freshness, late-arriving data, and business rules.
* Integrate data quality checks at ingestion, transformation, and pre-publish stages.
* Participate in requirements analysis, test strategy, test planning, risk assessment, test estimation, and release validation activities.
* Validate REST APIs, backend services, databases, and microservices through automated and manual testing.
* Perform performance and load testing using JMeter or BlazeMeter, analyse bottlenecks, and provide recommendations for performance improvements.

* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Developers, DevOps, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality software delivery.

* Mentor junior Quality Engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Experience:**

* 3–4 years of experience in Quality Engineering, with strong expertise in Data Engineering, Data Quality, or Data Reliability Engineering.
* Hands-on experience with data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, dbt Tests, Deequ, or equivalent tools.
* Strong SQL skills, including window functions, complex joins, and queries on large partitioned datasets.
* Minimum 2 year of hands-on coding experience in Python.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in ETL testing of Data Pipelines and Data Warehouse.
* Experience with cloud data lake technologies, including S3, Glue, Athena, Spark on EMR, and Apache Iceberg.
* Experience in API automation (REST APIs, Postman, API testing frameworks).
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and modern Quality Engineering practices.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience with test strategy, risk-based testing, test planning, and quality metrics.
* Experience in defect management, root cause analysis, and release quality validation.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience using AI-assisted testing tools to improve test design, automation development, execution, and maintenance (Claude Code preferred).

**Preferred Skills**

  

* Mastery of specialized data quality tools (e.g., Great Expectations, Informatica DQ).
* Proficiency with cloud platforms and data warehouses (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake).
* Knowledge of global data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and best practices for data governance.
* Experience testing microservices-based and distributed architectures.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools.
* Experience working on enterprise SaaS or publishing/content management platforms.

**Nice to Have**

* ISTQB Certification.
* Data Quality tool certified eg Informatica, Right Data etc
* AWS or Azure Fundamentals Certification.
* Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and the nuances of experimentation
* Experience with AI-driven Quality Engineering practices.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong ownership mindset with a quality-first approach.
* Strong ownership of data quality and reliability.
* Ability to identify and resolve the root cause of data quality issues.
* Good judgement on when a quality check should block, quarantine, or generate an alert.
* Ability to identify risks early and drive preventive quality practices.
* Quick learner with enthusiasm for adopting emerging technologies and AI-powered engineering solutions.
* Ability to mentor and coach team members while fostering a culture of quality.
* Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders.
* Self-driven, proactive, and capable of working in a fast-paced Agile environment.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

  
**Additional Information**

You must have the right to work and live in India.

**Location:** The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of our Bengaluru office to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office location to collaborate as required. title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.

Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.

**About Sarvam**
----------------

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.

**What this role promises you**
-------------------------------

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.

**Who you are**
---------------

We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.
* Building on MCP, or serving LLMs and embedding models in production.
* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**

FalconX is a pioneering team of operators, investors, and builders committed to revolutionizing institutional access to the crypto markets. Operating at the intersection of traditional finance and cutting-edge technology, FalconX addresses the industry's foremost challenges: Navigating the digital asset market can be complex and fragmented, with limited products and services that support trading strategies, structures, and liquidity found in conventional financial markets. As a comprehensive solution for all digital asset strategies from start to scale, FalconX operates as the connective tissue empowering clients with seamless navigation through the ever- evolving cryptocurrency landscape.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Security Operations & Threat Hunter with exceptional troubleshooting abilities and a deep understanding of both endpoint and cloud threats. The ideal candidate will be a key player in our Security Operations Center (SOC), proactively hunting for threats, analyzing security incidents, and ensuring the protection of our infrastructure across on-premise and cloud environments.

This role offers a distinct growth trajectory: beyond day-to-day triage and incident response, you will dedicate meaningful time to high-impact engineering projects, AI-driven security automation, and direct collaboration with senior engineering leadership.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Monitor, detect, and respond to security incidents across on-premise and cloud environments.
* Analyze security alerts from security tools to identify potential threats.
* Conduct forensic investigations and deep-dive analysis of security events to identify trends, attack techniques, and areas for improvement.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting across endpoint, network, and cloud environments to identify sophisticated cyber threats.
* Analyze security logs, behavioral patterns, and anomalies to detect indicators of compromise (IOCs) and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Investigate security incidents, perform forensic analysis, and provide actionable recommendations for mitigation and remediation.
* Develop and refine threat hunting methodologies, leveraging frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain.
* Automate threat detection and analysis using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Continuously monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack trends to improve detection and response strategies.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3+ years of experience in security operations, threat hunting, or a similar cybersecurity role.
* Experience working with log data for detection and response across Cloud, EDR, Network, and related telemetry.
* Experience developing and deploying effective detection rules (e.g., YARA, Sigma, SQL-based rules, Network signatures).
* Strong understanding of network security monitoring, packet analysis, and log correlation.
* Deep understanding of advanced threat detection methodologies and threat intelligence.
* Proficiency in analyzing attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) based on frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation for security operations (Python, PowerShell, or Bash).
* Solid understanding of endpoint security, identity management, cloud security, detection engineering, vulnerability management, incident response, and threat intelligence.
* Strong communication skills, an inquisitive mindset, and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and collaborate across teams.

**Working Model & Schedule**
----------------------------

* **Global Exposure & Quarterly Rotations:** To foster close alignment with our distributed engineering teams and US leadership, this role follows a structured quarterly time-zone rotation (rotating through San Francisco/PST, New York/EST, and local daytime business hours). This cadence provides direct access to senior leadership, high-visibility global projects, and cross-functional teams across the organization.
* **Rotational On-Call Coverage:** Shared participation in rotational weekend on-call pager duty to triage critical incidents alongside team members and leadership.
* **Location & Hybrid Flexibility:** Based in Bangalore. During local daytime business cycles, work on-site from our Bangalore office to build strong peer relationships and cross-functional connections; flexible remote arrangements apply during global and US-aligned cycles.

title: Manager - Engineering (E-commerce)
description:

Chalhoub Group’s Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail.

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

**What you'll be doing**

Lead the E-Commerce Engineering capability across Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC/Demandware) and Shopify, owning technical execution, full-stack delivery, and operational reliability across all brand websites while building and developing a high-performing engineering team.

* Own platform technical execution and codebase governance across SFCC (Demandware) multi-brand realms and Shopify Plus applications.
* Oversee end-to-end frontend and backend code delivery using Node.js, ISML, SFRA (Storefront Reference Architecture), and modern JavaScript frameworks across all brand websites.
* Drive migration from monolithic SFCC setups toward composable, decoupled frontend microservices and API-first integrations.

* Oversee technical interfaces connecting e-commerce applications with middleware (MuleSoft), Order Management (Fluent OMS), POS (Oracle XStore), and payment gateways, and track DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes,Defect Escape Rate, MTTR).
* Manage production code deployments and implementations releases, constantly improving the process to reach a goal of multi releases per day.
* Own SFCC and Shopify platform from maintenance perspective making sure that everything is operationally working as expected without any disruptions.
* Direct, mentor a high-performing team of full-stack e-commerce engineers and tech leads, run performance reviews, career development paths, and adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code).
* Partner with the Architecture, Omnichannel, Product, and QA on workforce and capacity planning.
* Own end-to-end e-commerce engineering delivery across SFCC and Shopify, including integrations, release readiness, and production stability.
* Remain hands-on: contribute to complex implementation and plan, design, execute, and document functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing across integrated SFCC and Shopify systems for assigned scope.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* Minimum 10 years of total software engineering experience, including 5 years hands-on e-commerce full-stack development and 3 years directly managing engineering teams of 15+ people.
* Experience leading complex e-commerce platforms across SFCC and Shopify Plus in multi-brand retail environments, with strong ownership of integrations, performance, and operational reliability.
* Deep expertise in SFCC (Business Manager, SFRA, Controllers, Pipelines, Job Frameworks) and Shopify Plus, with mastery of ISML, HTML5, CSS3/SASS, JavaScript (ES6+), and React.
* Strong command of Node.js, RESTful API design, GraphQL, headless architecture, and microservices integration.
* Experience with e-commerce search engines (Algolia, Constructor.io), CDN/caching (Fastly/Cloudflare), catalog indexing, GitLab CI/CD, Git workflows, and automated build and release pipelines.
* Practical experience with observability and APM tools (Datadog, Splunk) for site health, error logging, and incident response, and SAFe/Agile delivery (Jira/Confluence); familiarity with Claude Code for AI-assisted engineering.

**What we can offer you**

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

description:
**AI Engineer - SAP S/4HANA**

**POSITION PURPOSE:**

We are seeking an AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI and agentic architectures within the SAP S/4HANA and SAP BTP ecosystem. This role designs, builds, and deploys AI agents, Joule extensions, and LLM-driven solutions that make SAP business processes conversational, autonomous, and intelligently automated.

You will leverage foundation models (Claude, GPT, Gemini), SAP Joule, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol to create solutions that reason, plan, and act across SAP workflows — interoperating with external agent ecosystems while adhering to Clean Core principles and Responsible AI governance.

**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design and build AI agents that autonomously orchestrate SAP S/4HANA business processes using multi-step reasoning, tool use via A2A and MCP protocols limiting human interaction to the bare minimum.
* Develop SAP Joule extensions using Joule Studio — creating custom skills, domain-specific agents, and conversational interfaces for natural language interaction with SAP data and transactions.
* Integrate and orchestrate foundation models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) via SAP Generative AI Hub — managing prompt engineering, model routing, guardrails, and agentic orchestration for production-grade deployments.
* Implement MCP-based tool-use patterns giving AI agents secure access to SAP systems — wrapping released APIs and OData services as MCP-consumable tools via the Integration Suite MCP Gateway.
* Build A2A-compliant multi-agent architectures enabling bidirectional communication between Joule, custom BTP agents, and external platforms.
* Establish prompt engineering standards, evaluation frameworks, and Responsible AI guardrails (hallucination mitigation, grounding validation, PII handling, audit trails).
* Explore and pilot emerging SAP AI capabilities (Joule Studio 2.0, SAP AI Agent Hub, ABAP AI agentic features) and provide adoption recommendations.
* Collaborate with SAP Lead Developers and Solution Architects to ensure AI solutions align with Clean Core architecture and the broader S/4HANA landscape.
* Mentor development teams on generative AI, prompt engineering, agentic design patterns, and AI-augmented workflows.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred).
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years focused on Generative AI application development and/or agentic AI architectures.
* Deep hands-on experience with LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) — including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, and multi-turn reasoning.
* Proven experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or SAP-native orchestration — with strong understanding of MCP and A2A protocols.
* Working knowledge of SAP BTP AI services — Generative AI Hub, AI Core, Joule Studio, SAP Build, and Integration Suite.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, data models, released APIs, and business processes in at least one functional domain (Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, or Order-to-Cash).
* Strong understanding of AI safety and governance — hallucination mitigation, content moderation, agent access control, and observability.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate business processes into agentic workflows and demonstrate AI value to non-technical stakeholders.
* Growth mindset with passion for rapid prototyping and staying current with AI advancements and the SAP AI roadmap.

title: Customer Engineer
description:
### **Nexla, briefly**

Nexla is the data connectivity layer for enterprise AI. Over 1,000 bidirectional connectors give agents real-time access to data and actions over MCP. Nexla's Agentic Data Integration handles high-volume streaming ETL, CDC, and Document ETL. At the core of the platform is Helix, a context engine that continuously learns from metadata, schemas, telemetry, and documentation to give agents accurate context and keep pipelines reliable. Nexla processes over a trillion records a month for enterprises including DoorDash, LiveRamp, LinkedIn, and J&J. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running.

**Role, briefly**  
You would be the technical bridge between our customers and our engineering teams. When a customer's pipeline breaks, or our Ops team spots something before the customer does, you take it: dig through logs and connectors, find the actual cause, and see it through to a fix. This is not ticket triage. You own the resolution, including the engineering conversations it takes to get there. Python, SQL, and REST APIs are the tools you reach for daily.

**What you'll own**

* Technical resolution, end to end. Cases raised by customers and issues surfaced by our Ops and L1 team: first investigation, root cause, and the fix, including driving it with the engineering teams who own the code.
* The investigation itself. Logs, connectors, the Nexla environment, and whatever Python or shell you need to write to see what is actually happening. Written fast, often thrown away.
* What you learn, written down. Known and newly found solutions in the knowledge base so the next person does not start from zero, plus the Global Alerts and visibility updates that go to Sales and Customer Success when an issue reaches past one customer.
* The customer's experience of all of it. Clear updates across email, tickets, Slack, and calls, and support through product releases.

**The hard problem**

Most of what lands on you will not be a bug in our code. It will be a third-party API that changed without telling anyone, a file that arrived malformed, an auth token that quietly expired, or a schema that moved. Across more than a thousand external systems, each with its own quirks, the hard part is working out which side of the boundary the problem sits on, and proving it, while the customer is waiting and reasonably assumes it is ours.

**Must-haves**

* 3 to 6 years in data engineering, technical support, or a closely related role.
* Strong Python. You write scripts quickly to debug something or set up an alert, and you are comfortable throwing them away afterwards.
* Solid SQL and hands-on with databases: Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* REST APIs and the authentication around them: OAuth2, SSO, and token-based. You have debugged an auth failure that was not documented anywhere.
* Comfortable on both Linux and Windows, and with data formats including CSV, XML, JSON, and Parquet.
* You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.

**Bonus points**

* Apache Airflow.
* You have worked a support or on-call rotation before and know what good looks like.
* Data integration, ETL, or iPaaS background.

**You'll thrive here if**

* You can write a clear update to a frustrated customer and a clear one to a busy engineer, and you know those are different jobs.
* You like digging. Logs, traces, and the part where it finally makes sense.
* You do not handle a problem half-understood.
* You work well with people who are under pressure, without adding to it.

*One thing to be clear about: this role runs on a shift rotation with weekend coverage shared across the team. We do not run late-night shifts, but your week will not always be Monday to Friday. If that does not fit your life, this is not the right role, and it is better to know now.*

**The practical stuff**

Bengaluru preferred, and we are open to candidates working remotely elsewhere in India. The role runs on a rotational shift pattern with weekend coverage shared across the team. We do not run late-night shifts. Compensation includes base salary, bonus, and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title.

**Worth a look before you apply**

* **What we are building now.** MCP Studio and Express, our two newest bets.
* **Who uses us, and why.** nexla.com/customers
* **The product you would be supporting.** docs.nexla.com
* **Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax" seriously.** Read the founder story
* **Everything else.** nexla.com · Blog · All open roles

### **Why Nexla? Why now?**

A few large companies - DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably.

The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it." That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer." That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone.

A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one.

That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express.dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires.

The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

description:
**Title: Frame Design Engineer - Tapeout Operations (3pm-12am shift)**

  
  

**About GF**  
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power efficient and high-performance solutions for high growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

  

**Introduction:** Be a part of our global team that is at the forefront of providing cutting-edge global technology solutions. We are seeking candidates with a strong passion for new technologies and advanced manufacturing, as we continue our Industry 4.0 Digitalization journey using technologies such as Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, robotics, big data analytics and more.

  
  
  

**Summary of roles**

GlobalFoundries looking for a highly motivated engineer to work in the Global Tapeout and Mask Organization, as a Frame Design Engineer located in Bangalore, India. The successful candidate will support tapeout operations activities that would vary from frame design for a range of technologies to process improvements for enhanced productivity and quality. This role requires working with worldwide Frame and other engineers that use semiconductor manufacturing tools (i.e., lithography and metrology) and test tools in our Fabs. The successful candidate would be engaging in continuous process improvement in the increasingly complex world of chip manufacturing by applying Failure Mode and Effect Analysis, structured problem-solving and driving actions to reduce risks.

  
  
  

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Engage in daily operations activities: facilitating technology frame requirements, frame structures layout and frame generation for chips, ad-hoc change execution, work queue prioritization, and work hand-off across geographic locations.

* Use or customize internally developed software tools and commercially available software tools to enhance design process productivity. (Include generating input files that drive automation for Fabs and Mask House.)

* Make decisions to hold, escalate, promote and reject tape out support issues in alignment with FAB, Tape out Logistics Integration and AEs.

* Interact with other teams such as Application Engineering, Product Engineering, Release Team, and Design Enablement, to assist with providing a best-in-class Customer Tape-out Operations experience.

* Close collaboration with FAB and TD Team to provide solutions to improve efficiency, reduce costs and improve cycle time.

* Participate in assessing our team business processes and suggest continuous improvements as well as automation opportunities to enhance the team’s productivity.

* Ensure that processes are well documented, that failure modes are assessed and have mitigation and detection in place,

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements, and programs.
  

  
  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Masters Degree in related field OR Bachelor's Degree in EE/ECE of 1+ years of industry experience OR engineering diploma with 2+ years of relevant industry experience

* Working knowledge of Unix shells and interest/aptitude to learn domain-specific programming/scripting languages/data formats

* Experience with Cadence Mask Compose is a big plus

* Experience with Virtuoso environment and SKILL Programming, Device Layout Knowledge/Experience will be a plus

* Ability to communicate and work with cross-geographic, multi-cultural global teams

* Fluency in English Language - written & verbal - is a requirement.

* Analytical problem solving and decision-making skills are basic requirements.
* **This role requires working in an evening shift (3pm-12am) and supporting weekend and holiday coverage on the assigned dates.**

title: GPU Logic Design Engineer
description:
**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**The Role and Impact:**

As a GPU Logic Design Engineer, you will be instrumental in developing the next generation of graphics IPs, contributing directly to the design and optimization of register transfer level (RTL) coding for cutting-edge GPU blocks. Your day-to-day work will involve creating high-performance logic designs, ensuring they meet power, performance, area, and timing goals. The work you do will be integral to delivering innovative solutions for Intel's graphics products, directly impacting millions of users worldwide.

The Graphics IP team within Intel's Data Center Group (DCG) is dedicated to delivering world-class graphics and compute solutions for integrated, discrete, and data center AI products. Leveraging continuous innovation and engineering excellence, the team supports Intel's overall mission to drive technological advancements and deliver high-performance computing solutions. This role places you at the forefront of industry-leading graphics IP development efforts.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Develop logic designs and create RTL code for graphics IPs, including compute, display, and media blocks.
* Optimize logic designs to meet power, performance, area, and timing goals, ensuring design integrity for physical implementation.
* Participate in defining the architecture and microarchitecture features of GPU blocks.
* Review verification plans to ensure design features are accurately validated across hierarchies.
* Drive unit-level verification and resolve RTL test failures, implementing corrective measures to ensure design correctness.
* Collaborate with SoC teams to ensure high-quality integration of GPU blocks.
* Utilize industry-standard tools and methodologies for design and verification.

-------------------

* Bachelor's degree or Masters in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 4+ years M.Tech and 5+ B.tech with hands on experience in RTL coding, logic design, and verification processes for GPU or similar domains.
* Proficiency in Verilog/System Verilog and familiarity with hardware design flows and methodologies.
* Experience with synthesis, timing analysis, and structural design using tools such as Lint and CDC.
* Knowledge of computer architecture, microarchitecture, and static timing analysis.
Proficiency in programming/scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for automation.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong analytical skills and experience in low-power design and power optimization techniques.
* Familiarity with ASIC design flow and industry-standard verification tools/methodologies.
* Exposure to ML/AI and HPC workload knowledge.
* Effective team player with strong communication skills and a continuous learning mindset.

WSP is seeking an AI Engineer to develop and support production-oriented Generative AI solutions for the Middle East AI portfolio from the Bengaluru GCC. * Develop GenAI applications, agents and automation workflows using approved designs and engineering standards.

* Apply responsible AI controls including validation, guardrails, content filtering, traceability and human oversight.
* Develop clean, reusable and well-documented Python components and participate in code reviews.
* Support deployment, monitoring, incident resolution and continuous optimisation of AI solutions.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline.
* 0–3 years of relevant software, data or AI engineering experience, including internships or strong project experience.
* Working knowledge of Python, REST APIs, SQL and software engineering fundamentals.
* Practical understanding of LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering and evaluation methods.
* Exposure to Azure AI services, Git-based development, CI/CD and cloud security principles.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

Microsoft Azure

REST APIs, microservices, event-driven and serverless patterns, secure API-first integration

description:

The **AI Master Trainer** will play a pivotal role in delivering high-quality AI/ML training programs to college students and young professionals. This role involves designing and planning engaging sessions, facilitating classroom and virtual workshops, developing and refining training content, and ensuring strong learner engagement and outcome tracking.

● Proven ability to design session plans, learning flows, and engaging teaching content

title: Chief Technology Advisor
description:
**What you'll bring**

**Essential**

* **Seniority:** 18+ years in enterprise technology, with at least eight years in senior customer-facing roles such as chief architect, field CTO, pre-sales leader or technology consultant, at a systems integrator, OEM, consultancy or large enterprise.
* **Executive network:** trusted relationships with CIO, CTO and CISO-level leaders at large Indian enterprises, multinationals or GCCs, in sectors such as banking and financial services, telecom, technology, manufacturing and life sciences.
* **Architecture breadth:** current expertise across data center infrastructure (compute, storage and networking), hybrid and multi-cloud (IaaS, PaaS and SaaS), security and automation, with recognized depth in at least one area such as AI infrastructure, cybersecurity or cloud.
* **Complex environments:** a track record of shaping and governing complex architectures and large deployments for organizations such as Fortune India 500 companies, multinationals and their GCCs.
* **Regulatory awareness:** working knowledge of India's data protection and sector regulations (DPDP Act, RBI, SEBI, IRDAI and CERT-In) and how they shape architecture choices.
* **Multi-vendor fluency:** an objective, hands-on understanding of global OEM technologies, and of how OEMs, distributors and partners take technology to market in India.
* **Commercial acumen:** you build ROI and TCO business cases that stand up to scrutiny, shape large deals and lead complex RFP responses.
* **Executive presence:** you make complex technology simple for boards and business leaders, and earn credibility with engineers.
* **Collaboration and influence:** you lead through influence, negotiate well and work effectively with geographically dispersed teams across the US, EMEA and APAC.
* **Education:** a bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science (B.E./B.Tech or equivalent).

**Desirable**

* **Advanced degree:** an MBA, or a master's degree in engineering or computer science.
* **AI infrastructure:** hands-on experience with GPU cluster design, high-performance networking (InfiniBand or RoCE) and high-density, liquid-cooled data center design.
* **GCC experience:** experience setting up or scaling a GCC, or advising GCC leadership on technology strategy.
* **Transaction platforms:** experience architecting high-volume transaction platforms in banking, payments or fintech.
* **Service delivery:** experience with IT service delivery and modern operating models, including DevOps, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
* **Certifications:** TOGAF, CCIE or CCDE, professional-level cloud architect (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud), CISSP or NVIDIA.
* **Thought leadership:** a public profile as a speaker, author or industry contributor.

**Why this role**

* Shape WWT's growth in India, with the backing of a global company that has the scale, partnerships and labs to deliver.
* Advise across the world's leading technology OEMs, so your recommendations are shaped by what is right for the client.
* Grow a global career, working with peers and leaders across the US, EMEA and APAC.

We strive to create an environment where all employees are empowered to succeed based on their skills, performance, and dedication. Our goal is to cultivate a culture of belonging that encourages innovation, collaboration, and respect for all team members, ensuring that WWT remains a great place to work for All!

WWT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you need any accommodation or adjustment during the hiring process, please let your WWT recruiter know.

**Make a new world happen.**

**#LI-AC1**

Requirements:

**Chief Technology Advisor**

Customer-facing executive role . International Sales . India

**Role at a glance**

**Location**

Bengaluru, with Pune considered for the right candidate.

**Focus**

Strategic Indian enterprises, plus the India operations and Global Capability Centers (GCCs) of our multinational clients

**Experience**

18+ years in enterprise technology, including at least eight years in senior customer-facing advisory roles

**Travel**

Frequent travel across India's major metros, with periodic international travel

**Works with**

Account teams, CSE pre-sales engineers, Management Consulting, delivery teams and OEM partners

**About World Wide Technology**

At World Wide Technology, we work together to make a new world happen. Our important work benefits our clients and partners as much as it does our people and communities across the globe. WWT is dedicated to achieving its mission of creating a profitable growth company that is also a Great Place to Work for All. We achieve this through our world-class culture, generous benefits and by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions for our clients.

Founded in 1990, WWT is a global technology solutions provider leading the AI and Digital Revolution. WWT combines the power of strategy, execution and partnership to accelerate digital transformational outcomes for organizations around the globe. Through its Advanced Technology Center, a collaborative ecosystem of the world's most advanced hardware and software solutions, WWT helps clients and partners conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology solutions for the best business outcomes and then deploys them at scale through its global warehousing, distribution and integration capabilities.

With over 16,000 employees across WWT and Softchoice and more than 60 locations around the world, WWT's culture, built on a set of core values and established leadership philosophies, has been recognized 15 years in a row by Fortune and Great Place to Work® for its unique blend of determination, innovation and creating a great place to work for all.

WWT has grown quickly in India, to more than 300 people in cities including Bengaluru and Pune. In 2026, Great Place to Work® India ranked WWT India third in its mid-size category.

Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT India today!

**About the role**

As WWT's Chief Technology Advisor (CTA) for India, you will be the senior technology voice for our clients in one of the world's fastest-growing technology markets. You will build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, chief architects and GCC leaders, help them shape their technology strategy, and turn that strategy into architectures, programs and measurable business outcomes with WWT and our global OEM partners.

India's technology landscape is moving fast. Enterprises are taking AI from pilot to production. Data center capacity is growing rapidly. GCCs are taking on global technology mandates. New data protection and cyber resilience rules are changing how infrastructure is designed. You will help clients navigate all of it with clear, evidence-based advice, proven first in WWT's Advanced Technology Center (ATC) and AI Proving Ground.

This is a senior, customer-facing role that leads through influence. You will work closely with our account teams, CSE pre-sales engineers, Management Consulting and delivery teams in India and around the world, and with the India leadership of our OEM partners.

Want to learn more? Explore the solutions and services WWT provides at wwt.com.

**What you'll do**

You will advise senior technology leaders as they modernize infrastructure, scale AI and move to hybrid cloud. Your work spans five areas.

**Be a trusted advisor to India's technology leaders**

* Lead executive conversations with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and GCC heads to understand their business priorities, technology roadmaps and constraints.
* Bring a clear, objective point of view on AI, data center modernization, hybrid cloud, networking and cybersecurity, drawing on the world's leading OEMs.
* Turn India's regulatory requirements into practical architecture decisions on data residency, resilience and security, including the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act and requirements from RBI, SEBI, IRDAI and CERT-In.

**Shape strategy and architecture**

* Run executive briefings, architecture workshops and enablement sessions with WWT experts in AI, networking, compute, storage, cloud, security, automation and application development.
* Guide clients from AI pilots to production, from private AI platforms to large GPU clusters, covering compute, high-performance networking and storage, and the power and cooling realities of India's data centers.
* Design resilient architectures for India's scale, including the multi-site data center and disaster recovery models expected in regulated sectors such as banking and capital markets.
* Use the ATC and AI Proving Ground to run objective, multi-vendor proofs of concept, so clients can validate before they invest. In a market that buys on evidence and total cost of ownership, this is a powerful differentiator.

**Connect global and local**

* Be the bridge between WWT's global account teams and the India operations and GCCs of our multinational clients, aligning local priorities with global strategy.
* Help clients deploy in India with confidence, working with CSE, supply chain and integration teams so solutions meet India's import, certification and support requirements.
* Know WWT's capabilities in depth, from the ATC, AI Proving Ground and global integration centers to consulting, digital and lifecycle services, and build strong relationships with the leaders behind them.

**Drive growth with account teams and partners**

* Partner with account leaders to build account strategies and executive relationship plans for a focused portfolio of strategic clients.
* Shape large, multi-OEM pursuits. Frame the business case, lead the technical narrative and support complex RFP responses, while making sure solutions are commercially sound and deliverable.
* Build strong relationships with the India leadership of our OEM partners to develop joint opportunities.
* Ensure smooth transitions from sales to delivery with CSE, Management Consulting, implementation and project teams.
* Provide accurate, timely management information, such as activity reports, bid reviews and forecasts, in line with WWT's quality and business processes.

**Build WWT's technical brand in India**

* Be a visible voice for WWT in India's CIO community through client events, industry forums such as NASSCOM and DSCI, and thought leadership.
* Mentor India-based CSEs and help grow a strong local technical bench.
* Keep your knowledge and certifications current through industry, product and sales training.

**What success looks like in your first year**

* Trusted, regular engagement with senior technology leaders across a focused portfolio of strategic accounts, each with a clear point of view and an agreed plan.
* Executive workshops and strategy engagements, in areas such as AI readiness, data center modernization and cyber resilience, that turn into qualified, multi-OEM pipeline.
* Clients routinely validating major technology decisions in the ATC and AI Proving Ground before they invest.
* Stronger alignment between WWT's global account teams and the India operations and GCCs of our multinational clients.
* A recognized WWT voice in India's CIO community, and a more confident, capable India CSE team.

title: Technical Support Engineer II
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara is looking for an experienced **Technical Support Engineer** to provide world-class hardware and software support experience to our customers. You will be a part of our **Tier 2 support team** within the umbrella of the Global Technical Support organization. You will be responsible for resolving complex customer problems and improving support across all teams. Your work will be collaborative in nature, working together with other support engineers in multiple support locations to serve our customers and troubleshoot complex issues.

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background with experience in a technical support role, proven customer-facing skills, and strong communication skills. You understand the day-to-day aspects of customer support including managing tickets, building knowledge base articles, and providing product feedback to Engineering and PM teams.

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Product Expertise**: Become an expert on Samsara's product portfolio of complete Internet of Things ("IoT") solutions combining hardware, software, and cloud to bring real-time visibility, analytics, and AI to operations across multiple industries.
* **Technical Troubleshooting**: Use your technical knowledge and product expertise to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues with medium to high complexity.
* **Responsiveness & Resolution**: Respond to customers and resolve their inquiries in a timely and helpful manner with a primary focus on meeting our SLA goals.
* **Documentation**: Partner with Enablement to author and maintain customer-facing knowledge base articles to help improve the self-servisablity for our end users.
* **Partnerships**: Work closely to develop partnerships with our Engineering and Product teams in order to reproduce bugs and build testbeds as necessary.
* **Feedback Loop**: Provide direct feedback to Support Management for product and process improvements to help enhance the customer experience.
* **Team Player**: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a hybrid position based in our Bengaluru office, requiring you to participate in an on-call rotation schedule to triage and manage high-severity issues and outages.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical), or other technical fields.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in support, engineering, or other technical roles.
* Fluent English is a must.
* Technical know-how - you're comfortable interfacing with engineers, translating complex technical concepts into everyday language, and working with SaaS systems.
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills coupled with the ability to influence individual contributors and leaders across the company.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, you can speak both Engineer and Human.
* Strong bias for action, ability to dive deep, and insistence on the highest standards.
* Ability to work in a hyper-growth environment with shifting priorities.
* Willingness to work flexible hours during nights and weekends is preferred.
* We are looking for someone with strong API/Mobile Apps experience

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience with industrial systems, electronics, tinkering with cars or IoT devices, or similar hands-on work is a big plus.
* Trilingual English, Spanish and French is a big plus.
* Strong familiarity with using CRMs like Zendesk or Salesforce.

#LI-hybrid

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
