title: SoC Design Verification Engineer - Bangalore
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for talented Design Verification Engineers to help verify and deliver Velaura's next generation Physical AI SoC. You will work closely with architects, RTL engineers, software engineers and system teams to establish confidence in the correctness, performance, reliability and safety of the design, from individual RTL blocks through complete hardware and software systems running real workloads.

This role focuses on system level verification. The scope spans boot and root of trust, clock and reset topology, low power behavior, and the IO and memory subsystems that carry real traffic. You will work in one or more of these areas, matched to your strengths and to program needs, and carry that work through sign off and into tape out.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive verification planning and execution for your assigned areas of the Velaura Physical AI SoC.
* Build and maintain SoC level simulation environments and flows for CPU based SoCs such as ARM or RISC-V.
* Verify boot flows, root of trust, security state transitions and firmware handoff.
* Verify clock and reset topology, power domains and low power behavior at system level.
* Verify IO and memory subsystem integration including PCIe and LPDDR.
* Run CDC and RDC analysis at SoC level and close findings with the design teams.
* Verify system level latency, bandwidth and QoS under representative workloads.
* Support SoC sign off criteria, coverage closure and tape out readiness.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 10 or more years in design verification, including significant SoC level experience.
* Experience leading or participating in multiple SoC verification projects, including sign off and tape out.
* Experience with SystemVerilog, UVM, C and C++ and coverage driven verification at system level.
* Experience managing simulation flows on CPU based SoCs such as ARM or RISC-V.
* Knowledge of IO and memory subsystem IP such as PCIe and LPDDR5 or LPDDR6.
* Experience verifying boot sequences and root of trust.
* Experience verifying clock and reset topology at system level, with hands on use of CDC and RDC tools.
* Experience with low power verification tools and UPF based flows.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Depth in one or more areas such as security, memory subsystem, interconnect or power management.
* Experience with HW and SW co verification and pre silicon software bring up.
* Experience with emulation and FPGA prototyping at SoC level.

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
AI Product Engineer (Full-Stack)

**Location:** Remote (India-based), Bengaluru preferred, with daily overlap with our UK and US teams

**Engagement Type:** Contract-to-hire, 3 months then ongoing

**Reports to:** CEO

About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.

Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion & Coach for early-learning educators.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an AI Product Engineer who builds with AI by default and cares deeply about the product. You’ll partner closely with our CEO to shape and move Audrey forward. You’ll turn ideas into clear decisions, then build them end to end alongside a small, collaborative engineering team.

This role suits someone who leads through clarity and trust, brings people with them, and helps the whole team do its best work.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner with the CEO on product direction: shape priorities, test assumptions, and turn ideas into clear, buildable plans.
* Design and build AI features end to end, including prompts and agents, retrieval, and the experience around them.
* Put evaluation and testing in place so AI quality is measurable and keeps improving.
* Ship full-stack features across front end, back end and cloud deployment.
* Work hand in hand with fellow engineers: share context, pair on problems, and help everyone get more from AI tools.
* Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs early and clearly.
* Build with privacy and safety in mind, including FERPA/COPPA alignment.

  

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

* **First 30 days:** learn the product, the teachers who use it and the team; get hands-on and ship a first improvement.
* **By 60 days:** own a meaningful part of the AI experience and deliver improvements on agreed timelines.
* **By 90 days:** help shape the next phase of the product roadmap with the CEO.

  

What We’re Looking For

* 5–8 years of full-stack software engineering: React/TypeScript front end; Node.js or Python back end; AWS.
* You’ve personally built and shipped at least one production LLM application used by real users. What you’ve built matters more to us than years on a résumé.
* Hands-on experience with prompt and agent design, RAG (embeddings, vector search, re-ranking), and evaluating LLM output quality.
* An AI-native way of working: you use AI tools every day and can show the speed it gives you.
* Leadership capability: you’ve owned a product area or driven product decisions, and you influence through ideas, trust and collaboration.
* A genuine product mindset: you’re curious about the teachers who use what you build, and you let that shape your work.
* A collaborative style: you make the people around you better and handle different viewpoints with tact.
* Self-directed: you move work forward with minimal oversight and speak up early when things go off track.
* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable with technical and non-technical colleagues across UK and US time zones.
* **Bonus:** ed-tech or early-childhood experience; FERPA/COPPA familiarity; early-stage startup experience.

  

What to Be Ready to Demonstrate

Be ready to walk us through an LLM feature you shipped: what you decided, how you built it, how you measured quality, and what you’d do differently. The process includes a paid take-home build exercise (AI tools encouraged). Sanitized examples are welcome; please don’t share confidential employer or customer information.

What We Offer

* Fully remote role with flexibility over how you structure your day.
* Ownership of the AI experience in a flagship product, with real influence over its direction.
* Direct work with the CEO and a real voice in product decisions.
* A collaborative, family-friendly, mission-driven environment at the intersection of education, media, and technology.

  

Why Join Us

This is a rare chance to shape the AI product of a growing global education company at a defining moment, and to help take Audrey into thousands of classrooms. If you want work that’s visible, technically meaningful, and genuinely useful for young learners and their teachers, this is it.

*Note: This is an India-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.*

*MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.*

title: Hardware & Firmware Engineer - Bangalore
description:
**About the role**

MetroSober builds self-service breathalyser and vending kiosks, which are already running in the field. Each kiosk combines our own PCBs, firmware on an ESP32 and an ATmega328P, and a Raspberry Pi controller.

You will own the kiosk electronics end to end: firmware, sensors, PCB design, and assembling and testing the boards. Your first big task is to move our hardware designs out of Autodesk Fusion 360 into open-source, standard formats.

**What you'll do**

* **Move our designs out of Autodesk Fusion 360 into open, standard formats.** This covers:
* Converting the schematics and PCB layouts to **KiCad** (via Fusion 360's Eagle export and KiCad's importer), then fixing footprints, net classes and copper pours.
* Checking each converted board against the original and against working kiosk hardware.
* Exporting the 3D enclosure to **STEP** (editable in FreeCAD).
* Producing vendor-neutral fabrication outputs: **Gerber + drill files** (or IPC-2581), **BOM** and **pick-and-place** files.
* Putting all hardware sources under **git**, with a short README for each board.
* **Make and own all PCB changes after the migration**, from schematic to layout to fabrication. Work with the fabrication and assembly vendors.
* **ESP32 firmware** (C/C++, PlatformIO) for the motor and dispense controller. This includes Wi-Fi/HTTP, mDNS and over-the-air (OTA) updates.
* **ATmega328P firmware** for the breathalyser board, using a JSON protocol over UART.
* **Breathalyser sensors**: maintain the current **semiconductor (MOS) sensor** (Figaro TGS2620), and bring up a new **electrochemical fuel-cell sensor**. That means designing its analog front end, sampling, temperature compensation and calibration.
* **Add a new IR / dispense sensor** that confirms a product has actually dropped.
* **Hand-solder and assemble boards**, including SMD rework. Bring them up, test them and debug them.
* **Debug how the boards talk to the Raspberry Pi** over serial (UART) and Wi-Fi/HTTP.
* **Document** designs, pin maps, calibration steps and test procedures. Support kiosk installation and field fixes when needed.

**Must have**

At least 1 year prior work experience.

* B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in ECE, EEE, Instrumentation or a related field.
* **At least one PCB you designed, had fabricated and assembled yourself.** Please share photos, the schematic and the layout. KiCad is preferred; strong work in EasyEDA, Altium or Eagle also counts if you're happy to work in KiCad.
* Hands-on ESP32 or Arduino firmware in C/C++.
* Solid soldering skills, including SMD parts (0603, SOIC, TQFP), and comfort with a multimeter.
* Basic analog electronics: voltage dividers, op-amps, ADC readings and filtering.
* You can debug hardware on a bench without step-by-step supervision.

**Nice to have**

* Experience moving designs between EDA tools (Eagle or Fusion 360 to KiCad), or managing hardware projects in git.
* FreeCAD, or enclosure work using STEP files.
* Gas or alcohol sensors (MQ-series, Figaro, fuel-cell), or transimpedance amplifiers.
* Debugging with an oscilloscope or logic analyser.
* Motor drivers, IR or optical sensors, demultiplexers.
* Basic Python or Linux (Raspberry Pi).

**What you get**

* Real ownership in a small team, working directly with the technical lead.
* Paid AI tooling provided by the company.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

* Service Management Technology & Architecture
* AI, GenAI & Intelligent Automation

* Outcome Ownership & Data-driven Decision-making
* Continuous Improvement & Technology Simplification
* Proactive Leadership, Accountability & Execution
* Product Engineering & Platform Ownership

**Owning outcomes**

* Translate customer and business priorities into measurable outcomes, balancing continuous innovation with service stability, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and escalations across BTI, BT UK, and partner teams, ensuring commitments are delivered and issues resolved.

**Growth mindset**

* Champion continuous learning, experimentation, and adoption of emerging technologies, particularly AI and intelligent automation, to improve customer experience and service performance.

**Customer first**

**Driving innovation and simplification**

* Set clear direction, empower teams to make decisions, and establish accountability for engineering quality, delivery commitments, and service outcomes.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**

**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required

Summary:
  
As an Application Support Engineer, a typical day involves acting as a software detective by proactively monitoring and analyzing various components of essential business systems. This role requires identifying issues swiftly and accurately, ensuring minimal disruption to operations. The engineer collaborates with different teams to trace problems, diagnose root causes, and implement effective solutions, maintaining the stability and performance of critical applications throughout the day.

Establish observability standards, governance, and best practices to improve platform adoption, reliability, and operational efficiency.  
Provide technical guidance, training, and support to engineering and operations teams on observability practices and tools.  
Integrate observability tools with IT Operations platforms such as ServiceNow, BigPanda, and other ICD solutions.  
Automate operational tasks, monitoring workflows, and reporting processes using PowerShell and Python scripts.  
Support CI/CD implementation and deployment activities using Git, Harness, Terraform, and related DevOps tools.  
Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and Configuration as Code (CaC) solutions for observability platform deployments.  
Collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to address their observability requirements and build optimal solutions  
Create technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge articles for observability solutions.  
Evaluate and implement emerging observability, automation, AI, and AIOps technologies to improve operational visibility and service reliability.  
Provide technical guidance, training, and support to engineering and operations teams on observability practices and tools.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.

* Document findings and solutions clearly to support knowledge sharing within the team.
* Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support in troubleshooting activities.

  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Dynatrace Administration.
* Strong analytical skills to monitor and interpret system performance data effectively.
* Experience in troubleshooting complex software environments and identifying root causes.

* Familiarity with incident management processes and tools to ensure timely resolution.
* Excellent communication skills to coordinate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
About Technology@Lilly
  
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
About Role
  
The Associate Director - Software Engineering is a technical leader responsible for the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of software and data engineering solutions, with a solid foundation in software and data engineering concepts and a proven track record of leading engineering teams. This role combines deep hands-on technical expertise with people leadership to set direction, grow talent, and deliver scalable, high-quality systems.
  
  
The Associate Director - Software Engineering brings a forward-looking view of technology and actively leverages AI in day-to-day engineering work from coding and testing to monitoring and decision-making to raise team efficiency and output. The role serves as the central point of accountability connecting engineering, architecture, product, and leadership to deliver high-impact solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Technical Leadership & Architecture:

Own the technical vision and architecture for software and data engineering initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and built to a high engineering bar.
  

* Team Leadership & Mentorship:

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software and data engineers, drawing on prior experience leading an engineering team; build a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous learning.
  

* Hands-On Engineering Depth:

Maintain a solid working knowledge of software engineering (languages, frameworks, design patterns, distributed systems) and data engineering (pipelines, data modelling, storage) to guide design decisions and unblock complex technical problems.
  

* Forward-Looking Technical Strategy:

Track emerging technologies and industry trends, and translate them into a forward-looking roadmap for the team's tools, architecture, and capabilities.
  

* AI-Driven Engineering Efficiency:

Champion the use of AI in day-to-day engineering work coding assistants, automated testing, intelligent monitoring, and AI-assisted decision-making to improve team velocity, code quality, and operational efficiency.
  

* Delivery Ownership:

Partner with product and program stakeholders to plan, estimate, and deliver engineering initiatives on time and to a high quality bar.
  

* Engineering Standards:

Establish and enforce engineering best practices code review, CI/CD, testing, observability, and security across the team.
  

* Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Work closely with product managers, architects, and other engineering leads to align technical solutions with business priorities.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 10+ years of software experience, including 2+ years leading an engineering team
* Hands on experience in fullstack cloud application development.
* Solid grounding in software engineering concepts (data structures, algorithms, design patterns, distributed systems) and data engineering concepts (ETL/ELT, pipelines, data modelling, warehousing)
* Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, AI-based testing or monitoring tools) to improve day-to-day engineering efficiency
* Proven ability to set technical direction and a forward-looking roadmap for a team
* Working knowledge of SDLC, CI/CD, cloud platforms, and API-based architectures
* Experience with cloud-native architectures and DevSecOps practices
* Exposure to MLOps or building AI/ML-powered product features
* Experience in regulated environments (GxP, SOX, CSV/CSA)
* Experience leading engineering teams in global, matrixed organizations

Core Competencies
  
Technical Leadership • Software & Data Engineering Depth • Team Building & Mentorship • Forward-Thinking Strategy • AI-Driven Efficiency • Delivery Ownership • Stakeholder Collaboration • Continuous Improvement

Up to 10% travel, including international

* Provide technical insights during supplier discussions, RFQs, and negotiation support activities.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes such as machining, sheet metal, casting, molding, welding, and assembly.

* Experience with product costing, should-cost analysis, and cost reduction methodologies.

* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and bills of materials.

* Familiarity with ERP, PLM and CAD tools

* Knowledge of lean manufacturing, value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE), and design-to-cost principles.

* Exposure to AI & data analytics tools (python, tableau)

* Experience working with global suppliers and cross-functional international teams.

* Prior experience leading technical initiatives or workstreams.

At Trane Technologies™ and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King®, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. **What’s in it for you:**

Trane is excited to announce an incredible opportunity for a talented professional to join our team as an **Associate Engineering Manager - Engineering Design**. In this pivotal role, you will facilitate the design and manufacturing of our current & next line of exciting products. As a Associate Engineering Manager – Engineering Design, you will collaborate closely with the design & cross-functional teams globally to build industry-relevant products that meet required specifications for our global customers. The projects could be in the areas of Productivity, New product development, Quality and reliability, Agile, New technology platform and others.

**Where is the work:**
  
This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule (4 or more days onsite per week) based out of Bangalore.

  

**What you will do:**

* **Lead & Develop a High-Performing Team:** You will inspire, mentor, and lead a talented team of mechanical design engineers. Your primary focus will be on fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and innovative environment where team members can thrive. You will manage the full talent lifecycle, including setting clear objectives, conducting performance reviews, and creating robust development and growth plans for every engineer.
* **Drive Project Execution & Excellence:** You will be accountable for the team's successful delivery of engineering projects, ensuring they meet critical milestones for quality, on-time delivery, and cost. This includes leading rigorous design reviews, providing expert technical guidance, and ensuring all deliverables are of the highest quality and ready for manufacturing.
* **Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Serve as a key technical partner to other departments. You will collaborate closely with leaders in Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations to resolve technical challenges, streamline processes, and ensure seamless integration throughout the product lifecycle.
* **Advance Engineering Capabilities:** You will stay at the forefront of engineering tools and methodologies, driving the adoption of best practices within your team. This includes championing process improvements, overseeing the use of CAD and PLM systems, and identifying opportunities to leverage new technologies to boost productivity and innovation.
* **Contribute to Strategic Vision:** You will play a key role in shaping the future of our engineering function. By managing resources, aligning team priorities with business goals, and contributing to the technology roadmap, you will help ensure our design capabilities remain best-in-class.

  

**What you will bring:**

* **Leadership & Experience:** A mechanical engineering background with 13+ years of progressive industry experience, including at least 5 years in a direct people management role.

* **Core Engineering Design:** Extensive hands-on experience in mechanical design, with demonstrated success in New Product Development (NPD), VAVE (Value Analysis/Value Engineering), and design automation. You should have a strong command of **Design for X (DfX)** principles, including Design for Manufacturing, Quality, Circularity, and Cost.

* **Technical Proficiency:** Deep expertise in leading 3D CAD software (e.g., Creo, SolidWorks) and a strong command of PLM processes and tools (particularly Teamcenter). Your experience must include demonstrated proficiency in core HVAC or similar mechanical domains, including structural design, refrigeration system components, sheet metal fabrication, and complex piping and tubing layouts.

* **Advanced Methodologies:** A solid understanding of integrating advanced capabilities into the design process, such as Model-Based Definition (MBD) and Product Manufacturing Information (PMI), to automate workflows and reduce rework.
* **Innovative Mindset:** A passion for staying current with emerging technology trends, including AI-driven generative design, design for additive manufacturing, AR collaboration, and IoT-driven design.
* **Strategic Contribution:** The ability to help shape the future of engineering design by experimenting with new technologies and contributing to the strategic roadmap.
* **Exceptional Communication:** Superb written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly and effectively.

We have a Relaunch Program for professionals looking to restart their careers after a break. If you come with a career break of at least 12 months and match the work experience requirements mentioned, you are welcome to apply.

**Job Description**: Senior Engineer – Modeling & Simulation (Individual Contributor)

**Location**: Trane Technologies, Engineering & Technology Center (ETC), Bangalore

**Summary:**
  
The Modeling & Simulation team is seeking a highly skilled and collaborative **Senior Engineer – Acoustics** to lead advanced predictive modeling efforts. In this role, you will apply state-of-the-art numerical methodologies to solve complex noise and vibration challenges across our diverse product portfolios.

The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise spanning **both vibro-acoustics and aero-acoustics**. This role requires a unique balance of rigorous engineering execution alongside a global perspective—focusing on commonizing acoustic methodologies and simulation standards across different regional engineering teams to meet varying regional customer and regulatory requirements.

.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Advanced Modeling & Simulation:** Develop, validate, and execute high-fidelity numerical models to predict and optimize the acoustic performance of HVAC systems, transport refrigeration units, and components (such as compressors, fans, structures, and air handlers).

ü **Aero-Acoustics & Fluid-Structure Interaction:** Conduct Computational Aero-Acoustics (CAA) simulations to predict flow-induced noise, fan noise, and turbulence-driven acoustic phenomena.

ü **Vibro-Acoustics & Structural Dynamics:** Analyze structural-acoustic coupling, structure-borne noise transmission, and vibration propagation using Finite Element Method (FEM) and Boundary Element Method (BEM) solvers.

ü **Regional Commonization & Standards:** Champion efforts to standardize and commonize acoustics simulation methodologies globally. Collaborate with international design centers to harmonize workflows while addressing varying regional regulations and market requirements.

ü **Experimental Correlation:** Collaborate closely with physical testing laboratories to design validation tests, analyze dynamic measurement data (sound power, vibration, modal testing), and correlate experimental results with simulation models.

ü **Design Optimization:** Partner with product development teams to provide actionable, physics-based design recommendations early in the development cycle to reduce noise and enhance sound quality.

ü **Innovation:** Keep abreast of emerging simulation technologies, and drive continuous improvement in simulation capability and speed.

Required Qualifications

• Master’s degree (M.S./M.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Acoustics, or a highly related technical discipline.

• PhD will be a plus.

* 3–5+ years of hands-on industrial experience in acoustics modeling and simulation..
* Knowledge in Acoustics and noise control (specific to HVAC products is desirable).

* Should be able to perform Acoustics (Aero/Vibro) simulations, with emphasis on fan/blowers.
* Good depth in CFD (or) FEA with experience in performing simulations is an added advantage
* Hands-on experience on Acoustics/CFD/FEA tool preferably Actran, ANSYS Mechanical, Fluent, CFX, or Simcenter.
* Theoretical knowledge of Acoustics, Numerical methods, Fluid dynamics and FEA.
* Experience in Acoustics testing is desirable.
* Experience in the HVAC industry is desirable.
* Knowledge of AI/ML, IIOT and digital twin is preferred.
* Strong teamwork, interpersonal, communication, and project management skills required.
* Knowledge of programming languages and proven examples of improving productivity using various scripts.
* Ability to work in a matrix team environment for the common objectives
* Be part of org initiatives and contribute to ensure progressive, diverse and inclusive environment imbibing Trane values and culture.

.

Personal Attributes
  

* Highly analytical with strong problem‑solving capability.
* Self-driven, with the ability to manage work priorities independently.
* Collaborative mindset with strong initiative to influence design improvements.
* Proven ability to apply best‑practice approaches and engage in continuous learning.
* Ability to lead technically within cross-functional programs and drive engineering clarity.

-----------------

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started - and as a manager, you guide the way.  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

title: Platform Hardware design Engineer
description:
**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

Position Overview: As a Platform Hardware Design Engineer, you will contribute to the end-to-end development of advanced platform hardware, translating platform level requirements into circuit and component level specifications and ultimately into high quality board designs. You will work across the hardware development lifecycle, including architecture and requirements definition, component selection, schematic design, PCB implementation, design reviews, board fabrication and assembly support, power-on, bring-up, debug, validation, and delivery. This is a hands-on engineering role for candidates who enjoy solving complex hardware problems and working across disciplines to turn system requirements into reliable, manufacturable hardware. Our Business Group You will be joining the Silicon and Platform Engineering Group (SPE), an organization at Intel committed to advancing Intel's mission of delivering world class silicon and platform solutions. The group focuses on developing integrated systems that align with customer needs and support Intel's broader goals of leadership in technology innovation. SPE collaborates across diverse domains to ensure Intel platforms meet performance, reliability, and scalability requirements. Our work sits at the intersection of silicon, board hardware, firmware, validation, signal and power integrity, mechanical and thermal engineering, PCB technology, manufacturing, and system integration. Our hardware engineers have a broader responsibility than executing an individual design. They help establish platform architecture, guide implementation, identify and qualify appropriate hardware solutions, provide technical leadership during board power-on and debug, and lead resolution of schematic, layout, SI/PI, and hardware issues. Key Responsibilities Platform and Board Design • Translate platform level requirements into circuit level, component level, and PCB design requirements. • Design and develop complex platform boards incorporating high speed digital, analog and mixed-signal circuitry considering board/system-level design tradeoffs during development. • Own schematic development for assigned boards, subsystems, and functional blocks, including component definition and selection. • Develop electrical solutions associated with processors/SoCs, FPGAs, memory, high-speed interfaces, voltage regulators, clocks, resets, control interfaces, and platform-management functions. PCB Design and Implementation • Define PCB implementation requirements, including component placement, critical interfaces, routing rules, stack-up considerations, and other layout constraints. • Work closely with PCB layout engineers and guide board implementation from feasibility through design release/tape-out while meeting multidisciplinary platform requirements. • Review complex multilayer PCB designs for electrical performance, signal integrity, power integrity, manufacturability, and system requirements. • Apply high speed transmission-line and layout principles to critical interfaces. Power, Signal Integrity and Platform Considerations • Apply signal integrity and power integrity principles during board architecture, schematic design, component selection, and PCB implementation. • Design and review power delivery architectures, voltage regulation, sequencing, power budgeting, and platform power distribution. • Work with SI/PI specialists to analyze critical high speed interfaces and power delivery networks and incorporate analysis results into board design. • Understand platform level trade-offs involving electrical performance, power, thermal constraints, PCB implementation, component availability, and manufacturability. Board Bring-up, Validation and Debug • Develop and execute board power-on, bring-up, validation, and characterization plans. • Collaborate with architects, hardware engineers, validation engineers, firmware engineers, technicians, and other specialists during platform power-on and debug. • Troubleshoot board and system level problems and perform systematic root cause analysis. • Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, logic analyzers, and other measurement equipment for electrical characterization and debug. Analyze failures, determine root causes, implement corrective actions, and drive issues to technical closure. Cross-functional Execution • Collaborate with silicon, firmware, validation, SI/PI, mechanical, thermal, PCB layout, manufacturing, supplier, and program teams. • Incorporate feedback from verification, validation, manufacturing, and other stakeholders into hardware development and design improvements. • Support PCB fabrication, assembly, design-for-manufacturability, design-for-test, and hardware readiness. • Create and maintain design specifications, schematics, review documentation, design checklists, bring-up plans, validation reports, and other technical collateral. • Own assigned hardware deliverables and proactively identify technical, component, manufacturing, and schedule risks.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

Minimum Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 6+ years relevant hands-on industry experience in platform hardware, boar -level product development, PCB design, or related hardware engineering.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with PCB design, schematic capture, component definition/selection, and interaction with PCB layout teams.
* Strong fundamentals in digital and analog board design, electrical interfaces, mixed-signal design, and platform power-on.
* Experience with high density, multilayer board design and high speed PCB implementation.
* Understanding of high speed interfaces, transmission line fundamentals, signal integrity, and power integrity.
* Knowledge of voltage regulation, power delivery, clocking, resets, and sequencing.
* Experience with industry standard schematic capture and PCB design/review tools like Cadence environments including Allegro and Concept HDL alongside other industry-standard design environments.
* Hands-on experience with board power-on, bring-up, electrical measurement, hardware debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Strong problem solving, communication, technical documentation, and cross functional collaboration skills.

  
Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience designing complex compute, server, client, validation, FPGA based, or semiconductor development platforms.
* Experience with high speed I/O and memory interfaces such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, USB, Ethernet, or comparable technologies.
* Working knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, transmission line theory, impedance control, crosstalk, PCB stack-up, and power distribution networks.
* Experience with SI/PI, circuit, or power simulation tools.
* Experience with board-level power delivery, basic Verilog coding, power budgeting, voltage regulation, sequencing, and power integrity.
* Knowledge of PCB fabrication, board assembly, DFM/DFT, manufacturing flows, and component/BOM management.
* Experience taking hardware through multiple stages of the lifecycle from design through PCB implementation, fabrication, assembly, bring-up, validation, and deployment.
* Working experience in integrating the AI-based tools and agents in regular workflow
* Familiarity with scripting or automation, such as Python, for hardware development, validation, or debug is an added advantage.
* Experience working effectively with geographically distributed engineering teams, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

title: Engineering Manager/Senior Engineering Manager - Instawork Robotics
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**

Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000-year data gap” - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.

We are seeking an Engineering Manager – Instawork Robotics to lead and grow a high-performing engineering team building the core video and data platform behind Instawork Robotics, at the intersection of robotics, AI, and the future of work. You will be responsible for driving technical execution from concept to production, partnering closely with Engineering, Operations, Product, and Business teams to translate customer and business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

You’ll combine strong software engineering expertise with people leadership—guiding architecture and technical decisions, mentoring engineers. You’ll work across areas such as distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, observability, and high-throughput data workflows, supporting a platform already processing 50+ PB of data and 600K+ hours of video, and scaling fast across multiple clouds.

You are someone who thrives in ambiguous and fast-moving environments, is proactive and hands-on when needed, and has strong product and business instincts. You’ll play a key role in shaping both the technology and engineering culture at Instawork Robotics.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 5+ engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Drive technical execution across the full software development lifecycle, from architecture and design to production.
* Partner closely with Product, Operations, Robotics, and Business teams to translate customer and business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Drive initiatives across Ops, QA, ML, and platform teams: keep context across workstreams, track progress, and make sure work lands.
* Stay hands-on (about 20% of your time) and contribute to architecture, design reviews, technical discussions, and complex engineering problems.
* Partner with ML teams on data quality, throughput, and the formats models train on.
* Build and scale engineering teams through proactive hiring, interviewing, onboarding, and talent development.
* Identify and develop strong engineering talent through regular feedback, coaching, and career development.
* Establish strong engineering practices around code quality, system reliability, observability, and operational excellence.
* Protect the team’s focus: set priorities, push back on unplanned requests, and keep delivery commitments.
* Help shape the engineering culture and technical direction as Instawork Robotics continues to scale.
* Technical Mentorship: Act as a technical pillar for the team. Earn the respect of staff engineers and guide mid- and senior-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and architectural discussions to raise the bar for engineering excellence.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 2+ years in engineering management or people leadership.
* Deep backend and distributed-systems background, with range across the stack, including frontend and ML infrastructure.
* Experience running Kubernetes in production, ideally across more than one cloud, with an eye on storage and compute cost.
* Proven experience managing and mentoring engineering teams and building high-performing teams from the ground up or at scale.
* Strong track record of hiring and building engineering teams, including sourcing, interviewing, and closing strong technical talent.
* Strong technical depth with the ability to engage in architecture and system design discussions and make sound technical decisions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across Engineering, Product, Operations, Robotics, and Business teams.
* An AI-first mindset and experience with data-intensive systems such as video, computer vision, or ML training data. Robotics experience is a plus.
* You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced, 0-1 environments. You act like an owner, practice high-velocity decision-making, and know how to ship product quickly without sacrificing quality.

**Our Values**

* **Empathy, Trust & Candor**  
  We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* **Bias for Action**  
  We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* **Always Be Learning**  
  We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* **Act Like an Owner**  
  We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!

Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.

Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Senior Platform Hardware Design Engineer
description:
**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

Position Overview As a Platform Hardware Design Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the architecture, design, integration, bring-up, and validation of complex platform hardware. You will drive hardware development end-to-end, translating high level system requirements into detailed circuit and component specifications and leading designs from architecture and schematic development through PCB implementation, board power-on, debugging, validation, and delivery. You will be expected to make platform level technical decisions, resolve complex and ambiguous multidisciplinary problems, lead critical design reviews, drive cross-functional alignment, mentor engineers, and influence hardware development practices across projects. Our Business Group You will be joining the Silicon and Platform Engineering Group (SPE), an organization at Intel committed to advancing Intel's mission of delivering world-class silicon and platform solutions. The group focuses on developing integrated systems that align with customer needs and support Intel's broader goals of leadership in technology innovation. SPE collaborates across diverse domains to ensure Intel platforms meet performance, reliability, and scalability requirements. Our work sits at the intersection of silicon, board hardware, firmware, validation, signal and power integrity, mechanical and thermal engineering, PCB technology, manufacturing, and system integration. Our senior hardware engineers have a broader responsibility than executing an individual design. They help establish platform architecture, guide implementation, identify and qualify appropriate hardware solutions, provide technical leadership during board power-on and debug, and lead resolution of schematic, layout, SI/PI, and hardware issues. Key Responsibilities Platform Architecture and End-to-End Technical Ownership • Own complex platform-board designs from requirements and architecture through deployment. • Translate high level platform and silicon requirements into system architecture, circuit level requirements, component specifications, and PCB implementation requirements. • Define and drive critical platform architecture decisions encompassing high speed interfaces, memory, power delivery, clocking, resets, sequencing, control, management, and validation functionality. • Lead design trade-offs across electrical performance, SI/PI, thermal and mechanical constraints, board complexity, reliability, manufacturability, component availability, cost, schedule, and system compatibility. • Establish clear technical direction where platform requirements or implementation approaches are initially ambiguous. Advanced Board Design and Technical Leadership • Lead development of complex high density, multilayer PCBs incorporating advanced digital, analog, mixed signal, and power circuitry. • Own or provide technical leadership for schematic design, component selection, interface definition, PCB implementation, and design verification. • Establish PCB stack-up, placement, routing, impedance, power distribution, and critical interface requirements in collaboration with layout and analysis teams. • Lead schematic, layout, and technical design reviews and ensure critical findings are driven to closure. • Guide engineers and layout teams in resolving challenging schematic, PCB, layout, and design-for-X issues. • Identify and qualify new hardware solutions and reusable design approaches where appropriate. High-Speed Design and SI/PI • Apply deep understanding of signal integrity, power integrity, transmission-line behavior, high-speed interfaces, and platform power delivery to architecture and implementation decisions. • Partner with SI/PI engineers to establish design constraints and evaluate critical interfaces and power delivery networks. • Review PCB implementations for stack-up, placement, routing, return path continuity, high speed performance, and advanced SI/PI considerations. • Use modeling, simulation, measurement, and hardware correlation to guide technical decisions as appropriate. Power Architecture and Power Delivery • Define and review platform power delivery architecture, voltage regulation, sequencing, power budgeting, and power distribution networks. • Evaluate board and system power delivery tradeoffs, considering electrical performance, transient behavior, PCB implementation, and platform requirements. • Work with power integrity specialists to assess PDN behavior and drive required design improvements. • Apply simulation and hardware measurement to correlate power delivery behavior and resolve platform issues. Board Bring-up, System Integration and Debug • Define and lead power-on, bring up, validation, characterization, and debug strategy for complex platform hardware. • Lead resolution of difficult issues spanning board hardware, silicon, firmware, high-speed interfaces, power delivery, and system integration. • Use disciplined root cause analysis to diagnose failures and define corrective actions. • Provide hands-on technical leadership in the lab during critical power-on, bring up, and debug activities. • Apply appropriate measurement techniques and laboratory equipment for high speed, low speed, clock, power, and digital/analog circuitry. • Drive problems across engineering boundaries until technical closure. Program and Cross-functional Leadership • Serve as a senior technical interface across silicon, firmware, validation, SI/PI, mechanical, thermal, PCB layout, manufacturing, suppliers, and program teams. • Lead technical discussions and design reviews and communicate risks, tradeoffs, recommendations, and design decisions clearly to stakeholders. • Identify technical and execution risks early and drive mitigation plans. • Own technical readiness for critical hardware milestones, including design release, fabrication, assembly, power-on, and validation. • Develop and improve reusable architectures, review methodologies, design checklists, development flows, and engineering practices. • Mentor engineers through architecture development, schematic and PCB reviews, bring-up, debug, and technical problem solving. • Influence technical decisions and engineering practices beyond an individual board or project.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

Minimum Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 6+ years significant hands-on industry experience in complex platform hardware, PCB development, or system hardware engineering.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex board designs from architecture and requirements through schematic design, PCB implementation, bring-up, debug, and validation.
* Deep understanding of digital and analog board design, electrical interfaces, mixed-signal fundamentals, and system architecture.
* Strong knowledge of high speed interfaces, transmission line behavior, signal integrity, power integrity, memory, clocking, reset, sequencing, and power delivery.
* Proven experience with PCB technologies and layout techniques, including stack-up, placement, routing, and advanced SI/PI considerations.
* Advanced experience with schematic capture and PCB design/review environments.
* Strong hands-on laboratory experience and demonstrated ability to diagnose complex board level problems, determine root cause, and drive corrective actions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze board/system level design tradeoffs and make sound technical decisions.
* Ability to independently lead complex technical development activities and drive issues across multiple engineering functions.
* Strong technical documentation, presentation, written communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring capability.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Extensive experience designing complex compute, server, client, FPGA-based, semiconductor validation or other high performance platform hardware.
* Experience with high speed I/O and memory technologies such as PCIe, DDR/LPDDR, Ethernet, USB, or comparable interfaces.
* Deep understanding of PCB stack-up, placement, routing, high speed design, transmission lines, signal integrity, crosstalk, power integrity, and PDN design.
* Experience applying SI/PI, power, circuit, or electromagnetic simulation to board architecture and design decisions.
* Experience defining and validating sophisticated power delivery solutions, power management architectures and basic Verilog coding,
* Strong understanding of PCB fabrication, assembly manufacturing flows, DFM/DFT, component selection, and design release processes.
* Proven experience taking complex boards through the complete lifecycle from architecture through PCB implementation, fabrication, assembly, power-on, validation, and deployment.
* Experience establishing or improving hardware design flows, methodologies, design reviews, and reusable engineering practices.
* Experience with scripting or automation using Python or comparable tools for hardware development, analysis, validation, or debug.
* Working experience in integrating the AI-based tools and agents in regular workflow
* Experience providing technical leadership across multidisciplinary and geographically distributed engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor other engineers while remaining hands-on with architecture, board design, bring-up, and complex debug.

title: Director, Software Engineering | Enterprise AI Platforms, Infrastructure & Automation
description:
Meet the Team
  
In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms& Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.
  
Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
Your Impact
  
As the Director of AI Support& Automation, you will build and lead our Bangalore-based engineering pod as an elite 'player-coach' calibrated two levels below the VP. Combining direct architectural leadership with deep, hands-on systems development across MyAgent and Circuit, you will set the benchmark for AI platform reliability and quality.
  
You will enable the engineering organization to improve and optimize engineering processes and infrastructure, directing software systems development, application engineering, and software quality assurance for cloud-based and agentic AI platforms. Your directive spans across 5 core pillars:
  

* Pillar 1: Tier 3 Engineering& Escalated Platform Support: Act as the ultimate engineering escalation authority for MyAgent and Circuit. Lead hands-on debugging, root-cause forensic analysis, and kernel/runtime patch development for complex production failures, memory leaks, context bleed, and tool execution anomalies. Bridge the gap between SRE/L2 operational support and core platform architecture with zero-regression hotfix.
* Pillar 2: Premier AI Agent Test Harness& Evaluation: Architect and build an end-to-end, agent-driven test automation harness. Implement automated LLM-as-a-judge scoring frameworks, multi-agent simulation loops, deterministic task verification, and golden dataset benchmarking. Maintain uncompromising quality gates with >99% test pass rates across complex functional, regression, experimental, and safety workflows.
* Pillar 3: AI Software& GPU Performance Validation: Lead performance profiling, stress testing, and concurrency load and latency validation across dedicated on-premise GPU clusters and cloud runtimes. Optimize latency, token throughput, context cache utilization, and resource efficiency.
* Pillar 4: Modular SDK& API Developer Platform: Deliver modular, embeddable SDKs, React components, and headless APIs that empower thousands of Cisco software engineers to control, customize, and extend multimodal agentic experiences.
* Pillar 5: High-Talent-Density Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and lead a small, high-density pod (6–10 elite systems, AI, and test automation engineers) in Bangalore. Lead by example through daily code reviews, technical design RFCs, pair programming, and rigorous engineering craftsmanship.
* Technical Architecture& Testing Methodology:
* Deterministic Harness Layer: Unit and integration verification of MCP protocol compliance, tool schema validation, state machines, token exchange (RFC 8693), and memory storage persistence.
* LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation Framework: Automated scoring pipelines using calibrated frontier and on-premise judge models to evaluate grounding, factual accuracy, safety guardrails, hallucination rates, and task completion against versioned golden sets.
* Multi-Agent Simulation& Adversarial Red-Teaming: Automated agent swarms generating synthetic edge cases, malicious prompt injections, tool misuse attempts, and context overflow scenarios to proactively identify failure modes.
* Continuous Canary& Regression Pipeline: Automated staging deployment validation with automated rollback mechanisms, real-time latency tracing (OpenTelemetry), and semantic drift monitoring.

Minimum Qualifications
  

* Education: Bachelor's degree (B.Tech / B.E. / B.S.) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative STEM discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including 3+ years leading high-performing technical engineering teams and 2+ years of hands-on production experience with LLMs, agentic workflows, or AI platforms.
* Hands-on Coding Proficiency: Expert-level fluency in Python and modern TypeScript/JavaScript; strong working proficiency in Go, C++, or Rust for systems-level performance tuning.
* AI& Systems Architecture: Deep practical experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, Triton Inference Server, PyTorch, and vector databases.
* Modern Test& Performance Engineering: Demonstrated track record of designing large-scale distributed test harnesses, performance testing tools (k6, Locust, JMeter), browser automation (Playwright), and AI evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, Promptfoo, Eval Studio).

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Advanced Credentials: Master's degree (M.Tech / M.S.) or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering from a premier tier-1 engineering institution or top global research universities).
* GPU& Infrastructure Acumen: Solid understanding of GPU compute infrastructure, CUDA memory management, high-density server configurations, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Academic, Research, or Open Source Contributions: Demonstrated academic depth or research contributions in distributed systems, compiler optimization, GPU parallel computing (CUDA/Triton), formal software verification, major contributions to tier-1 open-source AI frameworks/benchmarks, or recognized technical patents in AI/systems engineering.
* Player-Coach Leadership Archetype: Proven ability to lead from the front, write production code, conduct deep architectural reviews, and inspire an elite engineering culture without relying on bureaucratic middle management.
* Enterprise Executive Communication: Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence, interact, and present technical architectures effectively across engineering, product, and executive leadership.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. **About the role**
------------------

The Pod Lead Engineer is a hands‑on software engineering specialist who leads a small, outcome‑focused delivery pod of 4–5 Pod Engineers. The role combines deep technical contribution with day‑to‑day pod leadership, enabling faster delivery through AI‑assisted / AI‑orchestrated SDLC practices.
  
Unlike a traditional team lead role, the Pod Lead Engineer operates in an AI‑native delivery model where AI tools and agents are used across the SDLC to accelerate requirements, design, code generation, testing, documentation, and release readiness. The Pod Lead Engineer contribute to technical direction, delivery execution, and engineering quality, while maintaining high standards of security, compliance, and operational excellence.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**1) Hands‑On Delivery Leadership (Core)**  

* Lead a 4–5 engineer pod by building software alongside the team, taking ownership of design, coding, reviews, and integration while breaking work into small, deliverable increments using modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automation, code quality gates).
* Drive frequent delivery of working software by ensuring clear definitions of done, measurable progress, and strong accountability for end‑to‑end delivery outcomes.

**2)AI‑Enabled SDLC Execution**  

* Embed AI across SDLC stages (requirements, design, build, test, deploy, operate) to accelerate solution design, safely generate/refactor code, create tests/automation, and support reviews and documentation.
* Establish pod‑level practices to maximize productivity with clear human accountability for decisions and release readiness, while maintaining required gates (e.g., quality checks, approvals) aligned to organizational standards.

**3)Technical Direction & Engineering Quality**  

* Act as the pod’s technical authority, defining architecture (within guardrails), patterns, component design, and integration approach.
* Own code quality, maintainability, performance, reliability, and security, while establishing pod‑level engineering standards (branching, coding conventions, reviews, CI/CD hygiene).

**4)Pod Management (Small Team Leadership)**  

* Provide day‑to‑day leadership for a 4–5 engineer pod, including task allocation, pairing strategy, prioritization, and removing blockers.
* Coach engineers in AI‑native ways of working (prompting, evaluation, safe AI use) while driving continuous improvement through retrospectives, root cause analysis, and measurable cycle‑time and quality gains.

**5)Stakeholder Alignment & Outcome Ownership**  

* Partner with the Senior Manager, AI Engineering and business/product stakeholders to clarify outcomes, scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, translating needs into clear technical milestones and deliverable increments.
* Provide transparent updates on progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions to ensure strong alignment and end‑to‑end outcome ownership.

**6)Governance, Risk, and Responsible Engineering**  

* Ensure adherence to security, data protection, and engineering governance standards while proactively managing risks from AI‑assisted development (e.g., licensing, security vulnerabilities, hallucinated code, weak tests).
* Maintain required auditable artefacts (documentation, traceability, approvals) aligned with enterprise expectations for controlled delivery.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Strong experience as a senior software engineer / technical lead / engineering specialist delivering production systems.
* Solid engineering fundamentals: API design (REST), data modelling, testing strategy, CI/CD, secure coding, reliability practices.
* Expertise in Java or .NET or Python along with UI and backend technologies like React, Flutter, PostgreSQL, Neptune DB.
* Strong credentials in Cloud environments like AWS.
* Experience leading small delivery groups (e.g., squad/pod/team) and delivering iteratively.
* Practical experience using AI development tools (Copilot, Amazon Kiro, Claude Code, agent workflows, automated test generation, AI‑assisted documentation).

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience working in AI‑assisted / agentic delivery models or rapid delivery “pods” / cohort models.
* Familiarity with governance practices with quality and assurance in delivery environments (e.g., gate reviews, readiness checks).

title: Lead Solutions Architecture Engineer
description:
Overview:

**Atlassian Architect**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Manager, Atlassian Products

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Senior/Principal

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – is the connective tissue of how work gets planned, tracked, and executed across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Atlassian Architect is the highest-level individual contributor on the Atlassian Products team, responsible for defining platform architecture, setting technical standards, and solving the most complex problems in HealthEdge's Atlassian environment. This is not an administration role – it is a design and engineering role. You will own the decisions that shape how the platform is built, governed, and extended, and your work will directly influence how thousands of employees across the company plan, collaborate, and deliver. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, the Architect will also shape the platform's AI readiness — ensuring the architecture supports Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo at enterprise scale.

You will serve as the technical authority for the Atlassian Products team – providing architectural guidance, mentoring Senior and regular Administrators, leading complex solution delivery, and acting as the primary point of escalation for problems that require deep platform expertise. You will also own strategic initiatives including instance governance, automation frameworks, API integrations, and migration or consolidation efforts.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Platform Architecture & Standards**
-------------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform architecture across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Access – defining how these tools are structured, governed, and extended at scale
* Establish and maintain technical standards for project design, workflow architecture, permission models, field configuration, and Confluence space taxonomy across the organization
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions that balance user needs with platform health – avoiding configuration sprawl and technical debt
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities, product roadmap changes, and Marketplace apps – assessing fit, risk, and adoption strategy
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation including design decisions, standards references, and solution blueprints

**Complex Solution Design & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Lead discovery and solution design for the most complex stakeholder requests – those that require cross-project thinking, advanced automation, or architectural changes
* Translate ambiguous business requirements from engineering, IT, product, and business functions into well-structured, scalable Atlassian solutions
* Deliver end-to-end implementation of high-complexity configurations, including multi-project workflow frameworks, advanced JSM service architectures, and cross-tool integrations
* Partner with the Manager, Atlassian Products to define and manage the platform improvement roadmap, sequencing initiatives by impact and feasibility

**Automation & Scripting**
--------------------------

* Design and implement advanced automation frameworks using native Jira/JSM automation and ScriptRunner (Groovy) for complex workflow logic, validators, post-functions, and listeners
* Build and maintain REST API integrations between Atlassian tools and external systems including identity platforms, ITSM tools, and business applications
* Establish automation standards and reusable patterns that the broader admin team can follow and extend
* Review and quality-assure automation and scripting work produced by Senior Administrators, providing technical guidance and improvement feedback

**Migrations & Consolidations**
-------------------------------

* Lead or architect Atlassian migration and consolidation projects, including instance-to-instance migrations, Server/Data Center to Cloud transitions, and post-merger platform integrations
* Perform pre-migration assessments including configuration audits, data mapping, and risk analysis
* Design migration runbooks and execute or oversee technical migration steps with appropriate rollback planning
* Ensure data integrity, permission continuity, and minimal disruption to end users throughout migration events

**Enterprise Governance & Security**
------------------------------------

* Own Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, authentication policies, IP allowlisting, and audit log management
* Design and enforce the organization-wide governance model for Atlassian – covering project creation standards, permission scheme governance, license management, and app approval processes
* Lead license optimization efforts, identifying consolidation opportunities and ensuring spend is aligned with actual usage
* Support security and compliance requirements including access reviews, data residency considerations, and audit evidence related to Atlassian platforms
* Serve as the technical lead for any Atlassian-related security incidents, misconfigurations, or compliance findings

**Team Mentorship & Technical Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the informal technical lead for the Atlassian Products team – the person Senior and regular Administrators bring their hardest problems to
* Mentor Senior Administrators on advanced configuration, automation, and solution design, actively developing their technical depth
* Conduct technical design reviews for significant platform changes proposed by team members
* Contribute to hiring by participating in technical assessments for Atlassian Administrator and Senior Administrator candidates
* Represent the Atlassian Products team in cross-functional technical forums and architecture discussions

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of deep, hands-on Atlassian platform experience with expert-level proficiency in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Atlassian architectures for large, complex organizations (thousands of users, dozens of teams)
* Expert-level proficiency in ScriptRunner (Groovy) scripting for advanced workflow customization, automation, and platform extensions
* Strong REST API experience with Atlassian platforms — building integrations, automating administrative tasks, and extending platform capabilities
* Proven experience leading Atlassian migrations or consolidation projects, including Cloud migrations
* Deep understanding of Atlassian Cloud security and governance including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and enterprise-scale permission management
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications strongly preferred – ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or Atlassian Certified Expert (ACE) designation
* Familiarity with how Atlassian platform architecture affects AI indexing quality and Rovo answer relevance
* Experience with advanced Marketplace apps at architectural scale (Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, Tempo)
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and applying them within JSM at an architectural level
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and DevOps tooling that integrates with Atlassian (AWS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT platform integration or multi-instance Atlassian consolidation

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have completed a thorough assessment of the current Atlassian environment, identified the top architectural gaps and technical debt priorities, and established yourself as the go-to technical authority on the team. Within six months, you have delivered at least one significant platform improvement, established or formalized key governance standards, and are actively mentoring the admin team. Within a year, the Atlassian platform at HealthEdge reflects clear architectural ownership — well-governed, well-documented, and built to scale — and you have meaningfully elevated the technical capability of everyone around you.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates at scale. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who wants to be the definitive technical expert on a platform that touches every part of the business. You'll have the backing of an engaged manager, a growing team of administrators to mentor, and a real mandate to shape how the platform evolves. If you want to do the most technically interesting Atlassian work of your career, this is that role.
