title: LLM & Agentic AI Performance Engineer
description:
**Job Details:**
================

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**The Role and Impact:**
------------------------

Join Intel's Data Center AI organization and help shape how LLM and Agentic AI workloads perform on Intel platforms.

Our team operates at a unique intersection of core performance optimization, AI frameworks, and customer-facing AI solutions. We bridge the gap between teams that deeply understand silicon and benchmarking and teams building real-world AI solutions, turning performance insights into software optimizations that developers and customers can use.

In this role, you will own end-to-end performance characterization and optimization of LLM and Agentic AI workloads, from Python-level frameworks and inference runtimes down to Linux, system architecture, and hardware performance counters.

This is not simply a benchmarking role. Benchmarking tells us what the number is. Your job is to understand why the number is what it is, identify the hardware or software bottleneck, and determine what needs to change to remove it.

Your work will translate into code contributions, framework optimizations, best-known configurations (BKCs), customer-ready solutions, and insights that help influence future Intel hardware and software.

If you enjoy working across the complete AI stack, from agent frameworks and LLM serving engines to NUMA, memory bandwidth, cache behavior, and silicon counters, this role provides an opportunity to work at that intersection.

  

**About the Team:**
-------------------

The AI Solutions and Toolkit Engineering team is part of Intel's Data Center organization, focused on enabling modern AI workloads and solutions on Intel platforms.

We work across the AI ecosystem, collaborating with AI framework and runtime developers, performance and optimization teams, hardware architects, open-source communities, and solution engineering teams.

Our goal is to take deep platform capabilities and performance insights and translate them into practical, optimized AI solutions that developers and customers can deploy.

The team works across areas including LLM inference, Agentic AI, AI frameworks and runtimes, workload optimization, open-source software, and datacenter AI systems.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  

* Characterize and optimize LLM and Agentic AI workloads across the complete software and hardware stack.

* Identify performance bottlenecks across AI frameworks, inference runtimes, operating systems, memory, compute, and platform architecture.

title: Design Verification Engineer- AI Accelerator - Bangalore
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for talented Design Verification Engineers to help verify and deliver Velaura's next generation Physical AI SoC. You will work closely with architects, RTL engineers, software engineers and system teams to establish confidence in the correctness, performance, reliability and safety of the design, from individual RTL blocks through complete hardware and software systems running real workloads.

This role focuses on our AI acceleration units. We are designing custom compute engines from scratch to deliver industry leading inference performance at best in class energy efficiency, and every gain has to come inside a tight power envelope. You will own verification of the hardware that makes those numbers real, where correctness means numerical behavior as much as protocol.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own verification of Velaura's custom AI acceleration units including matrix and vector compute engines.
* Work with architects to understand the intent behind a newly designed microarchitecture and turn it into detailed test and coverage plans, including the criteria that define correctness for numerical hardware.
* Build verification environments using SystemVerilog, UVM, C and C++, with stimulus, checkers, assertions, trackers and coverage that stay portable across block and subsystem environments.
* Develop reference models for GEMM and GEMV operations and compare hardware results against them.
* Verify accelerator data flow including operand staging, tiling, accumulation and result writeback.
* Verify precision, rounding and quantization behavior against the architecture specification.
* Verify throughput, latency, utilization and performance per watt against aggressive targets under representative LLM and vision workloads.
* Execute regressions through design and environment bring up, track progress using bug and coverage metrics, and support emulation and pre silicon bring up with the compiler and runtime teams.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 8 or more years verifying high performance compute or complex digital designs.
* High level understanding of LLMs including transformer structure and inference data flow.
* Knowledge of GEMM and GEMV operations and how they map onto hardware.
* Experience with SystemVerilog, UVM, C and C++, assertions and coverage driven verification.
* Experience building or using reference models in C, C++ or Python.
* Understanding of numerical formats and precision tradeoffs such as FP16, BF16, FP8 and INT8.
* Experience owning a block or unit of a design independently from test plan through coverage closure, including debug of complex failures.
* BS or higher in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior experience porting LLM or neural network models to RTL and verifying them.
* Experience verifying a custom accelerator developed from scratch rather than an integrated third party IP.
* Familiarity with systolic arrays, tensor cores, attention, KV cache or mixture of experts hardware.
* Experience with PyTorch, ONNX or compiler and runtime stacks for accelerators.
* Experience with formal verification, gate level simulation or silicon bring up.
* Exposure to performance modeling, power analysis, profiling and workload characterization.
* Familiarity with robotics, drones, autonomous vehicles or edge AI systems.
* Experience using AI assisted verification workflows to improve productivity and coverage.

**Compensation & Benefits**

At Velaura, we believe exceptional talent deserves exceptional rewards. Compensation for this role includes a base salary and very competitive equity compensation, allowing team members to share in the company’s long-term success.

The base pay listed represents a good faith estimate that the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation will depend on multiple factors, including the candidate's skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and geographic location.

In addition to base salary and equity compensation, Velaura offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; flexible work arrangements; professional development opportunities; and other benefits designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

Velaura is committed to pay equity and transparency and regularly benchmarks compensation to ensure we remain competitive in the market.

Velaura is building next-generation compute technology for cloud, edge, and Physical AI. Our solutions will enable robots, autonomous systems, drones, and other intelligent machines to operate efficiently in the physical world.  
This is an opportunity to help build foundational technology at a time when the industry is undergoing fundamental change. You will work alongside experienced leaders, architects, engineers, and operators who have delivered industry-defining products across mobile, cloud, semiconductor, and AI platforms. If you enjoy solving difficult problems, working across disciplines, and helping shape the future of Physical AI, we would love to hear from you.

title: AI Deployment Manager
description:
Why RapidClaims

US healthcare providers are paid only after every visit is turned into billing codes and submitted as a claim. That work is manual, slow and error-prone, and it is getting harder: claim denial rates have nearly doubled in a decade, from 7% to over 13%, while provider margins have fallen from around 10% to just 1% to 2%. Fixing the revenue cycle is now one of the biggest priorities for every health system in the country, and AI is how they are trying to fix it.

RapidClaims is an AI revenue cycle platform. Our autonomous agents code medical records, improve clinical documentation and manage denials, across 25+ specialties, with 98%+ coding accuracy. Clients include Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), specialty physician groups, community health centers and hospital systems. The company has raised $11 million in total funding from top investors, including Accel and Together Fund.

What sets us apart is speed to value. Where incumbents need tens of thousands of records and months of implementation to cover a new specialty, we need a few hundred records and hours. That advantage only counts if every client goes live quickly, stays stable and keeps growing. This role exists to make sure they do.

Why this role exists

In AI for the revenue cycle, the model is no longer the hard part. The hard part is making it work inside a real provider's workflow: their electronic health record (EHR) system, their specialties, their payer mix, their coders and their habits. The companies winning this market are the ones that get clients live fastest and keep them stable at scale. For a client, the deployment is the product.

Every client goes through the same journey with us: a pilot to prove value, a go-live, a period of stabilisation, then expansion into more of their work. Each stage depends on several teams pulling in the same direction, and we are hiring so that one owner holds that together.

The team you will join is responsible for pilots and live clients. You will work with engineering, data science, operations and quality control every day. You will wear multiple hats: problem solving, design thinking, debugging client issues and getting them resolved, and working with operations to manage client volume and bring efficiency.

What you will own

● The deployment. Run pilots, take clients live, stabilise them and lead their expansion. You are accountable for the client's outcome end to end, and you are the

person who knows where every client stands today.

● The translation. Convert client needs into clear, prioritised asks for our teams, and convert our progress into updates the client can act on. Nothing gets lost between the client and the people building for them.

● The resolution. Trace an issue across data, workflow, model and people, route it to the right owner, and drive it to closure. You report problems solved, not problems found.

● The tooling. Prototype agents, prompts and automations that remove manual steps from this job, deploy them, and measure the impact. Where a process is repeated, you are expected to build rather than repeat.

● The product. Turn patterns you see across clients into product features and process changes, so that every client after yours runs on what you learned.

Your first 45 days

● By day 15. You understand how a chart moves through our platform and through a client's revenue cycle. You have shadowed a live account, sat in on client calls, and mapped where work gets stuck and why.

● By day 30. You are running a pilot: discovery, data and integration scoping, workflow setup with data science, and the first quality review with the coding and quality control teams. You have shipped one small tool that saves someone on the team hours every week.

● By day 45. You own a portfolio of clients. One automation you built is in daily use by the team, and one product or process change exists because you saw a pattern across clients and made the case.

How we will measure success

● Time from pilot start to go-live, and from go-live to a stable, predictable weekly volume.

● Volume moving on time for your clients, and how quickly stuck work gets unstuck.

● Accuracy and quality outcomes for your clients, and how quickly issues reach data science when the model is the cause.

● Expansion: more of each client's specialties, sites and workflows moving onto the platform.

● Manual effort removed from the team by what you built.

What you bring

● 2+ years of experience, with shipped AI work. At least one AI-driven solution you built and put in front of real users: an agent, an automation, an internal tool or a product feature. You are hands-on with prompting, agents and evals, and you can

walk us through what you built, how you tested it, and what broke.

● A fast learner. Healthcare billing and medical coding are deep domains. You do not need to know them today, but you need to pick them up quickly and enjoy doing so. We are betting on learning speed over prior domain exposure.

● A structured thinker. You break messy problems down MECE (mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive), so nothing is missed and nothing is counted twice, and you can hold that structure while the details keep changing.

● Comfort with data. SQL, Python or advanced spreadsheets, enough to answer your own questions without waiting on someone else.

● Clear communication, written and spoken. You will talk to clients, engineers, coders and founders in the same day, and each of them needs a different version of the same truth.

● Comfort with context switching. This role moves between a client call, a stuck batch and a prompt that is not working. It is not a role with long quiet blocks, and the people who thrive in it find that energising rather than draining.

● High ownership and a problem-solving nature. You start with "how do I fix this", and you want the zero-to-one journey with the mess that comes with it.

Good to have. Exposure to healthcare, billing or US insurance. A prior client-facing or operations role at a startup. Familiarity with agent frameworks, structured outputs and tool calling, or LLM evaluation tools.

What this role is not

● Not an implementation or project-management role where you run a checklist and hand off. You build, debug and own the outcome.

● Not a pure operations role. If building your own tools does not excite you, this will feel like the wrong job.

● Not a quiet role. Several clients, several teams, many open threads at once.

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to work in Koramangala Bangalore office
* How many years of experience in AI
* How many years of experience in AI deployment
* Have you worked in Health care Industry
* How many No. of end-to-end deployment you have completed
* what is your team leading size
* Do you have managerial experience
* What is your current CTC
* What is your expected CTC
* What is your notice period
* Have you been interviewed by Rapid Claims before?

Whether you work across Machine Learning, Optimization, Statistics, AI Engineering, or MLOps, you’ll be challenged to harness Target’s impressive data breadth to build intelligent systems that power solutions for partners in Marketing, Supply Chain Optimization, Personalization, Network Security, Merchandising, and Guest Experience.  
Every team member in Target Data Science & Engineering is expected to contribute to high-quality modeling and engineering outcomes, write maintainable and performant production code, apply strong software engineering practices, and use retail domain knowledge to create measurable business impact.  
  
**Team Overview**  
The **MarTech team (Calibrate & Incentives)** builds intelligent decisioning capabilities that power personalized promotions and offers for Target guests. The team is responsible for developing and scaling AI/ML systems that help determine which guests should receive which offers, at what depth, through which channels, and under what business constraints.  
Promotions are a critical lever for guest engagement, loyalty, incremental sales, and enterprise growth. The team works at the intersection of AI engineering, machine learning, operations research, experimentation, marketing science, and production platform development to optimize promotional investments while improving guest relevance and business outcomes.  
  
**About the Role**  
As a **Senior AI Engineer** , you will help build and scale production-grade AI/ML capabilities that power Target’s promo optimization and personalized marketing ecosystem. You will partner closely with Data Scientists, Product Managers, Engineers, Analysts, and business stakeholders to turn AI ideas, models, and optimization strategies into reliable, scalable, secure, and high-performing production systems.  
This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building at the intersection of AI, software engineering, data platforms, and MLOps. You will work hands-on with Python, distributed data pipelines, Kafka and event-driven architectures, APIs, databases, model deployment, ML workflow orchestration, observability, and production support. You will also explore and apply emerging AI technologies such as Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, model evaluation frameworks, and intelligent workflow automation to solve real retail problems at scale.  
We are looking for someone with strong software engineering fundamentals, practical AI/ML deployment experience, and the ability to balance innovation with reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability. If you enjoy solving complex problems, building enterprise-grade AI platforms, and shaping the future of AI-powered retail decisioning, this is a great opportunity to make meaningful impact at Target.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build production-grade AI/ML applications, services, and platforms using Python and modern engineering practices, with a focus on clean code, testing, documentation, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Design and develop scalable data and ML pipelines for batch, streaming, and near-real-time processing using distributed data frameworks, Kafka or event-driven architecture, workflow orchestration tools, and enterprise data platforms.
* Implement end-to-end model training, evaluation, deployment, inference, monitoring, and lifecycle management workflows that can scale across large datasets and high-impact enterprise use cases.
* Partner with Data Scientists to convert prototypes, notebooks, statistical models, ML models, GenAI workflows, and optimization algorithms into reliable, reusable, and production-ready systems.
* Build and deploy REST APIs, microservices, model-serving endpoints, batch scoring jobs, and event-driven integrations that expose AI/ML capabilities to downstream applications and business workflows.
* Design scalable inference systems for promotion decisioning, segmentation, redemption prediction, offer ranking, campaign simulation, and personalized marketing use cases.
* Work with SQL, NoSQL, object stores, feature stores, and distributed data systems to store, retrieve, transform, and manage structured and unstructured data for AI/ML applications.
* Support production deployment and release management through CI/CD, containerization, automated testing, model versioning, automated validation, release controls, rollback strategies, and environment management.
* Implement MLOps capabilities including feature pipelines, model registries, experiment tracking, automated retraining, performance monitoring, data drift detection, model drift detection, lineage, governance, and reproducibility.
* Implement observability and reliability mechanisms, including logging, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerting, error handling, incident response, and root-cause analysis for production AI systems.
* Optimize AI/ML services for latency, throughput, cost, scalability, reliability, and operational performance.
* Evaluate and integrate Generative AI and LLM components, including prompt workflows, RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, model evaluation, guardrails, safety controls, and orchestration patterns where applicable.
* Explore agentic AI workflows, including planning, tool use, multi-step reasoning, workflow orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns for internal productivity and decision-support use cases.
* Contribute to design reviews, architecture discussions, code reviews, operational readiness reviews, and engineering standards for AI/ML systems.
* Troubleshoot production issues across data pipelines, model services, APIs, optimization workflows, and downstream integrations; identify root causes and implement durable fixes.
* Create reusable frameworks, libraries, templates, and best practices that improve AI engineering velocity and quality across the team.
* Communicate technical designs, trade-offs, system behavior, risks, and production performance clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, MLOps, or production ML systems.
* Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, with the ability to write modular, maintainable, well-tested, production-quality code.
* Experience building and deploying end-to-end AI/ML pipelines, including data preparation, feature engineering, model training, model evaluation, model deployment, inference, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model versioning, experiment tracking, automated validation, model registry, retraining workflows, deployment automation, and production monitoring.
* Experience designing and operating scalable model inference systems, batch scoring pipelines, APIs, microservices, or event-driven ML integrations.
* Experience working with distributed data processing systems such as Spark, Hadoop/Hive, or equivalent large-scale data platforms.
* Experience with SQL and one or more database technologies, including relational databases, NoSQL databases, object stores, or feature stores.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, system design, API design, testing, code reviews, error handling, debugging, and documentation.
* Working knowledge of machine learning concepts, model evaluation, feature engineering, model serving, and common ML frameworks.
* Experience with containerization, orchestration, cloud platforms, workflow schedulers, and modern DevOps practices.
* Good understanding of observability and reliability for AI/ML systems, including monitoring, alerting, logging, performance tracking, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Ability to partner effectively with Data Scientists and translate experimental models or notebooks into scalable production systems.
* Ability to work in ambiguous problem spaces, break down complex systems, and deliver high-quality solutions against business timelines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts, trade-offs, and system behavior to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong **Python engineering e**xperience with production-quality coding practices.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying **AI/ML pipelines** or ML-powered applications.
* Practical experience with **MLOps, model deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, and lifecycle management.**

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience **building applications** using **Generative AI and LLMs, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, evaluation frameworks, and model orchestration.**
* Exposure to **agentic AI systems**, including **multi-agent workflows,** planning, tool usage, orchestration frameworks, and autonomous or semi-autonomous decision-making patterns.

* Collaborate with middleware, database, storage, network, and security teams for cross functional troubleshooting.

* Expertise in Linux clustering technologies (Pacemaker/Corosync, HAProxy, Keepalived, etc.).

* Proficiency with Shell/Bash scripting, and familiarity with Ansible automation.

• Strong understanding of Linux internals: processes, memory, storage, networking, and kernel-level troubleshooting. • Experience with LVM, filesystems (ext4, XFS), permissions, SELinux, systemd, and performance analysis tools.

* Ability to troubleshoot hardware, OS, networking, and storage-related issues in a multi-tier environment.

* Hands-on experience with clustering and HA implementations in production.

* Experience with containerization (Docker/Podman) and orchestration (Kubernetes) is a plus.

* Experience in managed services or large enterprise IT operations.

We are seeking a Staff Power BI Engineer to join our Analytics and BICOE team. The ideal candidate will drive platform administration, scalability, governance, report development, and adoption, while partnering closely with engineering, data, and business teams to enable data-driven decision-making at scale. This role owns the end-to-end analytics experience, with a strong emphasis on Power BI platform administration, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), GCP BigQuery (BQ), cloud-native architecture, and high-performance SQL, enabling scalable, governed, and reliable analytics across Albertsons. Please note: This is primarily a Power BI administrator role, with Power BI development and ThoughtSpot administration, development skills considered a strong plus.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Key Responsibilities**

• 5–8 years of experience in data analytics, with expert-level skills in Power BI administration and Power BI Report development. • Own the end-to-end administration, governance, and operations of the Power BI platform, ensuring scalability, security, reliability, and performance. • Administer and manage Power BI tenant settings, licensing models, workspaces, and Premium capacities. • Monitor and troubleshoot Power BI Premium capacity utilization and performance using the Premium Capacity Metrics app and related tools. • Design, install, configure, and manage Power BI Gateways and enterprise data connections. • Troubleshoot and resolve Power BI ecosystem issues, including report access failures, dataset and dataflow refresh issues, gateway connectivity problems, and service disruptions. • Develop Power BI reports and semantic models based on business requirements. • Debug and optimize Power BI report and semantic model performance using Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and other third-party tools; provide recommendations to report developers. • Automate platform administration, monitoring, and governance using PowerShell or Python and Power BI REST APIs. • Configure and manage Power BI Copilot tenant settings, feature flags, and capacity prerequisites; establish enterprise guardrails and best practices for Copilot usage including dataset readiness, semantic model quality, and user enablement. • Monitor Power BI Copilot adoption, usage patterns, and platform impact, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders. • Enforce security and governance standards, including workspace controls and role-based access at scale. • Partner with engineering, data, and business teams to drive Power BI adoption and best practices. • Administer and manage ThoughtSpot SaaS environments, including tenant configurations and feature enablement. • Monitor ThoughtSpot platform health, usage analytics, and overall system performance. • Configure and manage ThoughtSpot users, groups, and role-based access control (RBAC). • Use ThoughtSpot Modeling Language (TML) to support content migration and promotion across non-production and production environments. • Coordinate with ThoughtSpot vendors and Albertsons change management teams to plan and execute platform upgrades. • Troubleshoot ThoughtSpot platform issues and work with ThoughtSpot support as needed.

  

**Required Qualifications**

• 5–8 years of experience administering and supporting the Power BI ecosystem in an enterprise environment. • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including a solid understanding of Fabric concepts and capabilities, is a strong plus. • Hands-on experience automating platform administration, monitoring, and governance using REST APIs and PowerShell or Python scripts is a strong plus. • Expert-level, hands-on experience with Power BI report development, paginated reports, and semantic (tabular) model development. • Deep expertise in Power BI platform architecture, including licensing models, Premium capacities, gateways, and tenant administration. • Advanced hands-on experience with PowerShell for automation and operational management. • Proven expertise in diagnosing and resolving complex Power BI performance and reliability issues. • Strong experience managing enterprise BI security models and access controls. • 5–8 years of experience in data analytics with expert-level skills in ThoughtSpot development. • Deep expertise in ThoughtSpot architecture and administration, including tenant configuration, feature rollout, and data modeling. • Hands-on experience with TML for environment migrations and content promotion. • Strong experience managing ThoughtSpot security, including users, groups, RBAC, and platform enablement, with the ability to define and enforce governance guardrails for ThoughtSpot Spotter 3. • Ability to support operational needs during US Pacific Time (PST) business hours.

  

Must-have skills

Power BI administration, BigQuery, SQL

Director, AI & Information Security

**What You Will Be Doing**
  
As a Senior Staff Architect, you will define and maintain the enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs. You will lead security reviews for infrastructure, cloud, SaaS, and emerging AI initiatives while enforcing Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust principles. Success in your first 6–12 months includes developing a cohesive security roadmap, establishing robust AI and cloud security guardrails, and partnering cross-functionally across Engineering, IT, and Product teams to reduce critical risks while elevating our overall security maturity.

**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* **Define and maintain** enterprise-wide security architecture, standards, and reference designs across network, endpoint, cloud, SaaS, and AI domains.

* **Establish and enforce** Secure-by-Design and Zero Trust Architecture principles, ensuring secure connectivity, micro-segmentation, and least-privilege access.
* **Lead the development** of our enterprise AI security strategy, establishing controls for Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), model poisoning detection, and responsible AI governance.
* **Design** enterprise network and endpoint security architecture, overseeing standards for NGFW, ZTNA, EDR, MDM, and secure SD-WAN.

* **Develop** robust Identity & Access Management (IAM) strategies, including SSO, MFA, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and passwordless authentication.
* **Conduct** comprehensive architecture reviews, threat modeling, and security assessments to identify risks and recommend strategic remediation to executive leadership.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with Engineering, Product, IT, and Legal teams to integrate security throughout the development lifecycle and align with regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
* **Provide architectural guidance** during major cyber incidents, partnering with SOC and Incident Response teams to evaluate events and strengthen future security controls.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of comprehensive cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years in a Security Architect or Lead Security Engineering role supporting enterprise-scale global environments.
* Deep technical expertise across network, endpoint, SaaS, cloud, and emerging AI security domains.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing Zero Trust Architectures and managing enterprise risk.
* Experience developing secure cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the courage and ability to influence cross-functional leadership on security best practices.
* **Education Requirements:** B.Tech/B.E. in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or GIAC.

description:

**Job Title:** Staff Engineer – Knowledge Management

  

**Location:** Bangalore

  

**Business & Team:**

The Chief AI Office (CAIO) drives the bank’s AI strategy, platforms, governance, and capabilities to accelerate the safe and scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise.

The Knowledge Management domain within CAIO creates the cognitive foundation of the bank by transforming business knowledge into trusted, governed, and reusable knowledge products.

As a Staff Engineer – Knowledge Management, you will work closely with Knowledge Governance & Framework Leads, Knowledge Platform & Engineering Teams, Business SMEs, knowledge owners, product teams, and DHP platform and DevSecOps teams.

  

**Impact & Contribution:**

You will directly support CAIO's objective of creating the bank's enterprise knowledge capability and trusted knowledge products that accelerate AI-powered transformation across the Group.

You will enable colleagues, copilots, and AI agents to access trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise knowledge, improving decision-making consistency and productivity.

You will help reduce duplication of knowledge, manual research effort, and rework by transforming fragmented information into reusable knowledge products with clear ownership, lineage, and controls.

You will build enterprise knowledge platform and retrieval capabilities that make business policies, procedures, controls, and operational knowledge AI-ready and safely consumable at scale.

You will strengthen governance, explainability, and risk management through metadata, provenance, permissions, evaluation, and auditability built into the knowledge lifecycle.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise Knowledge Products:** Design and build enterprise-scale knowledge products that transform unstructured information into trusted, reusable, and AI-ready assets.

**Ontology, Taxonomy & Knowledge Graphs:** Develop and maintain the enterprise ontology, semantic model, metadata, taxonomy, and knowledge graph that provide shared context across business domains.

**Knowledge Platform Engineering:** Engineer knowledge ingestion, enrichment, retrieval, and lifecycle management capabilities for governed knowledge products.

**Knowledge Governance:** Build and enforce knowledge governance controls covering ownership, lineage, provenance, classification, permissions, auditability, and lifecycle policies.

**Policy-as-Code & Decisioning:** Implement policy-as-code and deterministic decisioning capabilities to deliver consistent, explainable, and compliant AI outcomes.

**AI Guardrails & Retrieval Controls:** Develop AI guardrails, retrieval controls, and policy-aware access mechanisms to ensure only authorised and trusted knowledge is exposed to LLMs and agents.

**AI & Agent Integration:** Integrate the knowledge platform with LLM gateways, agent frameworks, evaluation frameworks, and AI platform services to accelerate safe adoption of agentic AI solutions.

**Quality, Evaluation & Observability:** Establish quality, observability, evaluation, and feedback loops to continuously improve knowledge accuracy, trustworthiness, retrieval effectiveness, and business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work across engineering, CAIO, CDO, product teams, business SMEs, and knowledge owners to translate complex business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

  

**Essential Skills:**

**Knowledge Management & Semantic Engineering:**

Deep expertise in knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, semantic modelling, taxonomy, and metadata management for enterprise-scale knowledge ecosystems.

Strong experience in unstructured data processing, document understanding, information extraction, entity resolution, and knowledge enrichment pipelines.

Strong stakeholder engagement and product-thinking skills with the ability to translate business knowledge, policies, processes, and controls into reusable enterprise knowledge products.

**RAG, GraphRAG & Retrieval:**

Hands-on expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, search technologies, and retrieval optimisation for AI-powered knowledge systems.

Experience building enterprise search, retrieval, discovery, recommendation, or similar knowledge capabilities is desirable.

**Knowledge Graph & Semantic Technologies:**

Hands-on knowledge of semantic and graph technologies including RDF, OWL, SKOS, SPARQL, ontology engineering, taxonomy management, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, and graph modelling concepts.

**Enterprise Knowledge Platform Engineering:**

Proficiency in designing enterprise knowledge platforms with scalability, reliability, observability, security, and cloud-native architecture principles.

Knowledge of ingestion pipelines, enrichment, retrieval, lifecycle management, APIs, integration patterns, and enterprise platform engineering.

**Knowledge Governance & Responsible AI:**

Strong understanding of knowledge governance, data governance, lineage, provenance, access control, compliance, permissions, classification, and auditability frameworks.

Experience implementing AI guardrails, retrieval controls, policy-aware access, evaluation mechanisms, and governance controls for safe consumption of enterprise knowledge.

**GenAI & Agentic AI Integration:**

Experience integrating LLM gateways, agent frameworks, AI platforms, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and model orchestration services.

Familiarity with agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, MCP patterns, and tool-based reasoning systems is desirable.

**Policy-as-Code & Decisioning:**

Ability to implement policy-as-code, executable knowledge, rules engines, and deterministic decisioning patterns to support explainable and compliant AI outcomes.

Experience with BPMN, DMN, policy engines, and executable knowledge is desirable.

**Programming Languages & Tools:**

Strong programming experience with Python as the primary language, together with TypeScript/Node.js and SQL for platform engineering, APIs, data pipelines, and AI integrations.

Experience with cloud-based AI, knowledge management, semantic technologies, or knowledge graph platforms is desirable.

**Risk, Compliance & Enterprise Knowledge:**

Knowledge of risk, compliance, regulatory, and control frameworks within highly governed financial services environments is advantageous.

Understanding of process intelligence, process mining, business capability modelling, and decision modelling to capture and operationalise organisational knowledge is desirable.

**Collaboration & Engineering Capability:**

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Ability to work effectively across engineering, CAIO, CDO, and business stakeholders.

Clear communication and documentation skills with the ability to explain complex knowledge architecture, governance, and AI concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Strong ownership mindset with a focus on automation, continuous improvement, scalability, and reusable engineering practices.

  

**Education Qualification:**

Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

Relevant cloud or AI certifications, including AWS, AI/ML, or Generative AI certifications, are advantageous.

Our client is building the first precision health platform for pets , a sensor-driven, AI-powered ecosystem that decodes the health signals dogs give off every day, the ones most people miss, and turns them into insight you can act on.

It starts with EverBowl, a clinical-grade device that reads hydration, intake, body temperature, eating behavior, and the sound of a bite , building toward a single daily wellness score. Paired with the app and Protect+, our insurance-rewards membership, we're helping pet parents move from guesswork to knowing. Calm. Confident. In control.

We're not building another pet gadget. None of it works without firmware that never fails , sensors reading in sync, data flowing over BLE without loss, updates reaching every device in the field without bricking a single one. That's the problem this role exists to solve.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a firmware engineer to build and maintain reliable embedded systems for sensor-driven hardware, working closely with the Lead Firmware Engineer across sensor integration, connectivity, and power management.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Develop and maintain RTOS-based firmware for embedded devices, keeping real-time performance stable
* Implement drivers and communication logic for sensors over I2C, SPI, or UART, and support arbitration across shared buses
* Support BLE-based firmware development for reliable data transfer between devices and the cloud
* Contribute to firmware-level battery charging safety, thermal cutoff logic, and clock stability under real-world conditions
* Support OTA update mechanisms, including testing rollout and rollback behavior before release
* Debug hardware-firmware interaction issues using tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers
* Write and maintain unit and hardware-in-the-loop tests to catch issues before they reach the field

**You Might Be a Fit If…**
--------------------------

* You have a B.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, or related field
* You have 4+ years of embedded firmware experience
* You have a solid understanding of RTOS concepts and at least one communication protocol used in sensor-based systems (I2C, SPI, UART, or BLE)
* You're proficient in C and C++ for embedded and microcontroller-based systems
* You're comfortable reading datasheets and debugging at the hardware-firmware boundary
* **Bonus:** experience with battery charging circuits or power-path management
* **Bonus:** exposure to OTA update mechanisms for fleet-deployed embedded devices
* **Bonus:** experience working with thermal sensors, IMUs, or camera modules

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* Build firmware for hardware that's actually out in the field, on real dogs , not just on a bench
* Learn directly from the Lead Firmware Engineer while owning real pieces of the system
* Take ownership early, with a direct line to the people building the rest of the product
* Join a small, fast-moving team building a category-defining, sensor-driven product

**To Apply**
------------

Share your background, along with any embedded systems or firmware you've built and shipped. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short assignment as part of our process.

title: Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)
  
  
Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid – 3 days a week in office)
  
  
About Us
  
Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending.
  
Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed.
  
We're investing heavily in AI — building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production.
  
  
Technical Skills- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code.
- Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code.
- Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling.
- Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation.
- Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e.g., MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day.
  
  
Leadership & Ownership- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production.
- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences.
- At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams.
  
  
Mindset & Collaboration- Growth mindset — curious, always learning, and open to feedback.
- Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster.
  
  
Nice to Have- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes.
- Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted.
- Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling.
- Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching.
- Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure.
  
  
What to Expect- We value humility and collaboration — we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos.
- We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code — including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality.
  
  
#LI-RT

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The Impact You'll Make- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution.
- Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking).
- Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context.
- Build evaluation frameworks — both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) — so we can measure whether agents are improving.
- Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals.
- Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform.
- Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring.
- Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data.
  
  
#LI-RT

You'll bring fresh perspectives to existing monitoring approaches while independently solving complex infrastructure challenges that span multiple technology domains. Working with application, infrastructure, network, and cloud teams, you'll onboard services to monitoring, build insightful dashboards and intelligent alerts, troubleshoot telemetry pipelines, and create automation that improves operational efficiency.
  
At JLL, we believe the most effective teams are built when everyone is empowered to thrive, and this role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your skills while contributing to operational excellence. You'll independently design monitoring solutions for sophisticated use cases, evaluate existing implementations for improvement opportunities, and ensure solutions are scalable and maintainable. We embrace more innovative ways of working and prioritize opportunities to strengthen and advance your career, making this position ideal for an engineer who enjoys learning new technologies, solving technical problems, and growing expertise in observability practices.
  
  
**What your day-to-day will look like:**  
**Independent Design & Implementation:**  
Design and configure comprehensive Datadog monitoring solutions independently across infrastructure, applications, networks, cloud platforms, logs, and digital experience capabilities aligned with enterprise standards
  
Create and maintain well-designed dashboards, monitors, alerts, integrations, and service health views that provide actionable visibility into system performance and health
  
Evaluate and enhance existing monitoring implementations, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, reduce operational overhead, and increase observability effectiveness
  
  
**Technical Problem Solving:**  
Independently solve moderately complex to complex infrastructure and application monitoring challenges by analyzing metrics, logs, and traces while applying established methodologies

title: Senior Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)
  
  
Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid – 3 days a week in office)
  
  
About Us
  
Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. Together with our Bengaluru engineering team, we are building finance, accounting, payroll and expense management solutions that simplifies how businesses track and reconcile spending.
  
Thousands of finance teams globally use our product to streamline expense management, integrate seamlessly with leading accounting platforms, and are recognized for its clean design, usability, and speed.
  
We're investing heavily in AI — building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time.
  
  
What We're Looking For
  
We're looking for someone with 3+ years of software engineering experience (mid-level) or 6+ years (senior), with hands-on experience building LLM-powered or agent-based systems in production.
  
  
Technical Skills- Solid software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, data modelling, and clean, maintainable code.
- Experience building and running production systems in the cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers, Kubernetes or similar, and infrastructure as code.
- Hands-on experience with distributed systems: queues, async workflows, concurrency, reliability, and failure handling.
- Practical experience building with LLMs: tool use, agents, prompt and context engineering, RAG, and evaluation.
- Familiarity with agent protocols and ecosystems (e.g., MCP) and with using AI coding tools day to day.
  
  
Leadership & Ownership- Comfort working independently and handling ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, scope it, and drive it to production.
- Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining trade-offs to both technical and non technical audiences.
- At the senior level, we also expect you to lead projects and set technical direction, mentor other engineers, define evaluation and quality standards, and influence architecture across teams.
  
  
Mindset & Collaboration- Growth mindset — curious, always learning, and open to feedback.
- Works closely with the engineers who use these tools every day; you help the whole organization build software better and faster.
  
  
Nice to Have- Experience with trace analysis or log mining to find and fix agent failure modes.
- Experience building internal platforms or SDKs that other teams adopted.
- Background in observability, CI/CD, or developer productivity tooling.
- Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching.
- Open-source or public contributions in agent tooling or LLM infrastructure.
  
  
What to Expect- We value humility and collaboration — we're looking for people who can work as part of a team, not in silos.
- We expect engineers to take ownership beyond just writing code — including tests, documentation, and long-term system quality.
  
  
#LI-RT

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The Impact You'll Make- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution.
- Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking).
- Design context and memory management: retrieval (RAG), summarization and compression, session state, long-term memory, and repository-aware context.
- Build evaluation frameworks — both offline (benchmarks, regression suites) and online (production quality signals) — so we can measure whether agents are improving.
- Create feedback loops: capture and mine traces, find failure patterns, and turn them into better prompts, tools, skills, and evals.
- Build developer tooling and internal SDKs that make it easy for other teams to build on and adopt the platform.
- Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring.
- Work with engineers and stakeholders to identify high-value workflows, ship quickly, and iterate on real usage data.
  
  
#LI-RT

title: Experienced Product Review Engineer
description:
At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

**– Experienced Product Review Engineer (Structural Repairs)**

**Overview**

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

  
  

**Technology for today and tomorrow**

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and highquality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

  
  

**People-driven culture**

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

  
  

**Position Overview**

Operations Center team serves as the first point of contact for Boeing customers needing urgent technical support on maintaining/ operating Boeing commercial airplanes. The team works in a highly dynamic environment to: expeditiously resolve customer Service Requests (SRs); provide FAA compliance documentation; and report, analyze, and resolve technical/ safety events and issues.

Boeing India Engineering is currently looking for an Experienced Product Review Engineer (Structural Repairs) to support Operations Center capability at Bangalore, India. This position will focus on providing 24/7 support to Boeing commercial airplane customers. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on complex technical challenges in support of safe operation and return to service.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Prepare structural repair dispositions and engineering data required to show compliance with Boeing, customer and regulatory requirements, to maintain continued airworthiness.
* Apply broad knowledge of Boeing design and/or engineering principles.
* Assess and resolve product/process issues through the product lifecycle.
* Lead research of technical, operational and quality issues that cannot be resolved by customer and design interim and final engineering solutions.
* Lead others to analyze, conduct root cause analysis and develop dispositions for design nonconformances.
* Develop and implement product/process improvements.
* Analyze reported problems for potential safety issues; recommend and manage complex resolution.
* Collaborate with other support groups to expeditiously develop safe solutions, satisfying customer needs.
* Communicate with customers if additional information is needed or roadblocks arise
* Perform review of the requests and determine the best avenue for resolution Review outgoing messages for quality
* Develop customer correspondence for continued safe operation and maintenance of equipment; Correspond with Operators through BCS/ E-mail/ IM
* Lead the design of interim structural repairs and conducts static strength analysis.
* Develop and implement technical training curriculum for internal or external customers.
* Willing to support a 24/7 on-call rotation schedule and the ability to work variable shifts, including weekends or overtime.
* Being a self-starter with a positive attitude, high ethics, and a track record of working successfully under pressure in a time-constrained environment.
* Execute work independently without supervision
* Proactively seek information and direction to successfully complete the statement of work.
* Must be able to work collaboratively with cross-functional team. Must be willing to work flexible hours (early or late as needed) to interface with Boeing personnel around the world.
* Demonstrate strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills. Be fluent in written and spoken English.

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is required as basic qualification in Mechanical/Aerospace/Applied Mechanics/Structural engineering
* 7+ years of proven experience in Product Review Engineering/ Service Engineering.
* Good knowledge of Static and Fatigue analysis techniques (Boeing methodology preferred)
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* 7+ years of experience in structures engineering.
* Experience in repair disposition of metallic and/or composite structures.
* Experience supporting end users in a customer service role.
* Experience working with MRB (Material Review Board) activities related to aircraft structures.
* Experience with airworthiness regulatory agencies.
* Experience in transport category airplane certification or production/fleet support projects involving FAA approval.
* Experience in developing/ performing structural repairs in Airline/MRO maintenance environment
  

  

**Relocation:**

* This position does offer relocation within INDIA.
  

  

Applications for this position will be accepted until **Oct. 26, 2026**

  
  

**Export Control Requirements:**

This is not an Export Control position.

**Education**

Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Required

**Relocation**

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

**Visa Sponsorship**

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Shift rotation - weekdays (India)

  
  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not accept unlawful discrimination in our recruitment or employment practices on any grounds including but not limited to; race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or other characteristics covered by applicable law.

Accommodations may include but are not limited to: conducting interviews in accessible locations that accommodate mobility needs, encouraging candidates to bring and use any existing assistive technology such as screen readers and offering flexible interview formats such as virtual or phone interviews.

  

**Your Benefits**

title: Technical Lead – Data Engineering
description:
**Who are we?**  
  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

**Technical Lead – Data Engineering**

**Myntra Data Platform (MDP) | Bengaluru | 6+ Years**

**About the Role**
------------------

**Myntra Data Platform (MDP) powers the data foundation behind analytics, experimentation, personalization, ML and critical business decisions across Myntra.**

**We are looking for a hands-on Technical Lead – Data Engineering to build and evolve large-scale data processing, ETL and orchestration platforms, while helping shape the next generation of AI-native and agentic data engineering at Myntra.**

**This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring deep technical ownership—from architecture and production-quality code to performance optimization, troubleshooting and operational excellence.**

**The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in Spark, SQL, ETL, workflow orchestration, data modeling and modern lakehouse architectures.**

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Large-Scale Batch Processing**

* **Design, build and optimize large-scale batch processing systems using Apache Spark, PySpark and Spark SQL.**
* **Build production-grade pipelines handling high-volume transformations, joins and aggregations.**
* **Apply deep understanding of Spark DAGs, stages, shuffles, partitioning, joins, caching, memory and query plans.**
* **Diagnose data skew, shuffles, memory pressure, inefficient joins and partitioning issues.**
* **Optimize execution time, compute utilization and cost.**
* **Build reusable Spark libraries, frameworks and engineering patterns.**

### **ETL & Data Pipeline Engineering**

* **Build reliable ETL/ELT pipelines across ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment and publishing.**
* **Develop reusable pipeline frameworks and abstractions rather than one-off solutions.**
* **Design for incremental processing, backfills, retries, idempotency, dependencies and failure recovery.**
* **Ensure correctness, freshness, scalability and maintainability.**
* **Own pipelines from architecture development deployment production operations.**

### **Workflow Orchestration**

* **Design and operate large-scale workflows using Apache Airflow, Dagster or equivalent platforms.**
* **Orchestrate complex dependencies across Spark, SQL and data-processing workloads.**
* **Build reusable operators, components and orchestration patterns.**
* **Improve scheduling, retries, backfills, dependency management and operational visibility.**
* **Build self-service capabilities for developing, deploying and operating data pipelines at scale.**

### **Databricks & Lakehouse Engineering**

* **Build and operate large-scale workloads on Databricks and Spark-based environments.**
* **Design lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Parquet or equivalent technologies.**
* **Optimize partitioning, file sizing, compaction, metadata, Spark and SQL workloads for performance and cost.**
* **Build platform capabilities that simplify compute, storage and data consumption.**

### **SQL, dbt, Data Transformation & Data Modeling**

* **Develop and optimize complex production-grade SQL and Spark SQL transformations.**
* **Build modular transformation models using dbt or equivalent frameworks.**
* **Establish standards for SQL quality, testing, documentation and dependency management.**
* **Troubleshoot expensive queries using execution/query plans.**
* **Design scalable relational, dimensional and lakehouse data models.**
* **Apply fact/dimension modeling, star schemas, SCDs and incremental models where appropriate.**
* **Translate business and analytical requirements into reusable data models across raw, curated and consumption-ready layers.**

### **Agentic Data Engineering**

* **Build AI-native data engineering capabilities across the end-to-end pipeline lifecycle.**
* **Design AI-assisted workflows that translate requirements into data models, SQL/Spark transformations and executable pipelines.**
* **Build agents that understand schemas, metadata, lineage, business semantics and existing pipelines.**
* **Apply LLMs/agents to SQL and pipeline generation, code review, testing, documentation and optimization.**
* **Build intelligent Spark/SQL optimization and pipeline RCA using execution plans, job metrics, logs, dependencies and historical performance.**
* **Automate generation of data-quality checks, tests, documentation and lineage metadata.**
* **Build natural-language/semantic interfaces for data discovery and safe pipeline creation/modification.**
* **Integrate agents with Airflow/Dagster, dbt, Databricks, Spark and metadata/catalog platforms.**
* **Design human-in-the-loop controls, validation, guardrails and evaluations for AI-generated SQL, code and pipelines.**
* **Build reusable agent frameworks, tools and APIs, not isolated AI demos.**

### **Data Quality & Governance**

* **Embed data quality into pipelines with automated freshness, completeness, schema and consistency checks.**
* **Establish standards for metadata, ownership, lineage and discoverability.**
* **Integrate with Unity Catalog or equivalent governance/catalog platforms.**
* **Design controls for PII, access management, auditing and sensitive data.**
* **Ensure AI-generated and human-authored pipelines follow the same quality, security and governance standards.**

### **Reliability & Operational Excellence**

* **Own production health of critical pipelines and platform components.**
* **Monitor failures, SLAs, freshness, data quality, performance and cost.**
* **Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex incidents.**
* **Eliminate recurring operational problems through automation, platform improvements and intelligent tooling.**

### **Technical Leadership**

* **Remain deeply hands-on while providing technical direction.**
* **Lead architecture/design reviews and review Spark, Python and SQL implementations.**
* **Mentor engineers across Spark, ETL, SQL, data modeling and production engineering.**
* **Build reusable frameworks and engineering standards adopted across teams.**
* **Drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering.**
* **Lead complex cross-team initiatives and influence architecture without direct authority.**

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **6+ years of hands-on Data Engineering / Software Engineering experience building production data systems at scale.**
* **Deep expertise in Apache Spark / PySpark, Spark SQL and Spark internals.**
* **Strong programming skills in Python, Java or Scala.**
* **Advanced SQL, query optimization and performance-debugging skills.**
* **Strong experience building production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines.**
* **Experience with Airflow, Dagster or equivalent orchestration platforms.**
* **Experience with Databricks or comparable Spark-based platforms.**
* **Experience with dbt or SQLMesh**
* **Strong understanding of data modeling and lakehouse architecture.**
* **Experience with Parquet, Delta Lake and/or Apache Iceberg.**
* **Experience with data quality, metadata, lineage and governance.**
* **Strong production ownership—from design and implementation through operations and RCA.**
* **Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture, code reviews and mentoring.**

**Good to Have**
----------------

* **Experience building LLM-powered developer tools, AI agents or engineering automation.**
* **Understanding of LLMs, tool/function calling, RAG, structured generation and agentic workflows.**
* **Experience applying AI to SQL generation, data discovery, pipeline generation, debugging or optimization.**
* **Experience with metadata catalogs, semantic layers, lineage or knowledge graphs for AI context.**
* **Experience building evaluations and guardrails for AI-generated SQL/code.**
* **Experience building multi-tenant/self-service data platforms, frameworks or SDKs.**
* **Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and Unity Catalog or similar governance platforms.**

**What Makes This Role Different**
----------------------------------

**You will build the engineering foundations that enable data engineering at Myntra scale — Spark processing, orchestration, ETL frameworks, data modeling, lakehouse architecture, governance and production reliability.**

As part of our ongoing digital transformation, we are investing boldly in AI-driven engineering and intelligent automation, and we’re now looking for a passionate, hands-on **Software Expert – Lead AI Developer** in Bangalore, India, to lead the practical adoption of AI across our software development lifecycle and help shape how we build the next generation of intelligent access systems.

  

#### **What You’ll Do**

  

* **Drive Practical AI Adoption:** Bring AI to life across the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements, architecture, and coding to code review, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and maintenance.
* **Partner with Development Teams:** Work side by side with engineers and architects to uncover real day-to-day engineering challenges and co-create pilot AI-enabled solutions that make a tangible difference.

* **Explore What’s Next:** Evaluate emerging AI development tools, models, frameworks, and agentic approaches, including locally hosted and open-source LLMs, with a clear view of their cost, performance, and operational trade-offs.

In this role, you’ll become the go-to technical point of contact for AI-assisted software development and play a key part in building a sustainable, AI-enabled engineering culture. Within your first 6–12 months, you’ll see the impact of your work in stronger internal AI capabilities, high-value use cases brought to life, and measurable gains in developer productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency. Here, your ideas are valued, your curiosity is encouraged, and you’ll have the exciting opportunity to shape the way our engineers work for years to come.

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience

We're hiring a Senior AI Engineer to own client engagements end to end across **Physical AI and robotics** — from understanding a client's real-world environment and constraints, to designing the perception and robotics ML solution, to building it hands-on through to delivery.
  
  
This is a solutions-lead role that codes. description:

### **Role description**

Grant Thornton INDUS is the in-house offshore center for Grant Thornton US- a member firm of Grant Thornton International, with offices in Bangalore and Kolkata. Our team of over 2,400 professionals specializes in Tax, Audit, Advisory, Operations, and Enabling functions, delivering exceptional client service, and driving excellence across all domains. We foster a transparent, competitive, and performance-driven environment where professionals are given opportunities to contribute to meaningful and impactful initiatives. Our young and dynamic workforce not only excels in delivering business outcomes but also inspires and gives back to the community through generous and impactful service initiatives.

**Why Join Grant Thornton INDUS?**

* **Empowered Environment:** We encourage autonomy and bold decision-making at all levels, shaping our future together.
* **Significant Contributions:** We provide ample opportunities to deliver transformational results and exceptional client service, driving innovation and growth.
* **Culture of Excellence:** We promote transparency, competitiveness, and a relentless drive to excel.
